fn cmd_count(args: &[String]) {
    // Usage: xsv count [options] [<input>]
    // Options: -h --help -n --no-headers -d delimiter
    let mut no_headers = false;
    let mut delimiter = b',';
    let mut input: Option<String> = None;
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < args.len() {
        let a = &args[i];
        if a == "-h" || a == "--help" {
            print!("{}", HELP_COUNT);
            return;
        } else if a == "-n" || a == "--no-headers" {
            no_headers = true;
        } else if a == "-d" || a == "--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    {}", "xsv count [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) {
                Ok(d) => delimiter = d,
                Err(e) => { eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
            }
        } else if a.starts_with("-") && a.len()>1 {
            // Could be -d with value attached? Like -d, or -d; - but original docopt expects separate? We handle -d as flag with value next, but also handle -d,? Let's parse: if starts with -d, split.
            // For simplicity, check if arg starts with "-d" and has more chars
            if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
                let val = &a[2..];
                match parse_delim(val) {
                    Ok(d) => delimiter = d,
                    Err(e) => { eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
                }
            } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
                let val = &a["--delimiter=".len()..];
                match parse_delim(val) {
                    Ok(d) => delimiter = d,
                    Err(e) => { eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
                }
            } else {
                eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    {}", a, "xsv count [options] [<input>]");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        } else {
            if input.is_some() {
                eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    {}", "xsv count [options] [<input>]");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
            input = Some(a.clone());
        }
        i+=1;
    }

    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };

    // If input is file path and index exists and not stale, use index
    if let Some(ref path) = input {
        if path != "-" {
            let idx_path = format!("{}.idx", path);
            if Path::new(&idx_path).exists() {
                if check_stale(path) {
                    eprintln!("The CSV file was modified after the index file. Please re-create the index.");
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
                if let Some(idx) = read_index(path) {
                    let total = idx.count;
                    let count = if no_headers { total } else { if total==0 {0} else { total-1 } };
                    println!("{}", count);
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Otherwise parse
    let data = read_input_bytes(input);
    match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) {
        Ok(parsed) => {
            let total = parsed.records.len() as u64;
            let count = if no_headers { total } else { if total==0 {0} else { total-1 } };
            println!("{}", count);
        },
        Err(msg) => {
            eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }
}

fn cmd_headers(args: &[String]) {
    // Usage: xsv headers [options] [<input>...]
    let mut delimiter = b',';
    let mut just_names = false;
    let mut intersect = false;
    let mut inputs: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut i=0;
    while i<args.len() {
        let a = &args[i];
        if a=="-h"||a=="--help" {
            print!("{}", HELP_HEADERS);
            return;
        } else if a=="-j"||a=="--just-names" {
            just_names = true;
        } else if a=="--intersect" {
            intersect = true;
        } else if a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    {}", "xsv headers [options] [<input>...]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) {
                Ok(d) => delimiter = d,
                Err(e) => { eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
            }
        } else if a.starts_with("-") {
            if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
                let val = &a[2..];
                match parse_delim(val) { Ok(d)=>delimiter=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
            } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
                let val = &a["--delimiter=".len()..];
                match parse_delim(val) { Ok(d)=>delimiter=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
            } else {
                eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    {}", a, "xsv headers [options] [<input>...]");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        } else {
            inputs.push(a.clone());
        }
        i+=1;
    }

    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };

    if inputs.is_empty() {
        // stdin
        let data = read_input_bytes(None);
        match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) {
            Ok(parsed) => {
                if parsed.records.is_empty() {
                    // no headers
                    return;
                }
                let header = &parsed.records[0];
                if just_names {
                    for h in header {
                        println!("{}", h);
                    }
                } else {
                    for (idx, h) in header.iter().enumerate() {
                        println!("{}\t{}", idx+1, h);
                    }
                }
            },
            Err(msg) => {
                eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    // multiple files
    let mut all_headers: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::new();
    for path in &inputs {
        let data = if path=="-" {
            let mut buf=Vec::new();
            io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut buf).unwrap();
            buf
        } else {
            match std::fs::read(path) {
                Ok(b)=>b,
                Err(_) => { eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", path); std::process::exit(1); }
            }
        };
        match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) {
            Ok(parsed) => {
                if parsed.records.is_empty() {
                    all_headers.push(vec![]);
                } else {
                    all_headers.push(parsed.records[0].clone());
                }
            },
            Err(msg) => {
                eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    }

    if intersect {
        if all_headers.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        // intersection of all headers, preserving order of first
        let first = &all_headers[0];
        let mut result: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        let mut seen: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
        for h in first {
            if seen.contains(h) { continue; }
            let mut in_all = true;
            for other in all_headers.iter().skip(1) {
                if !other.contains(h) {
                    in_all = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if in_all {
                seen.insert(h.clone());
                result.push(h.clone());
            }
        }
        for h in result {
            println!("{}", h);
        }
    } else {
        if inputs.len() > 1 {
            // auto just-names
            for headers in all_headers {
                for h in headers {
                    println!("{}", h);
                }
            }
        } else {
            let header = &all_headers[0];
            if just_names {
                for h in header {
                    println!("{}", h);
                }
            } else {
                for (idx, h) in header.iter().enumerate() {
                    println!("{}\t{}", idx+1, h);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            // Our parse function returns Err on mismatch, but we have records and offsets up to error? We need to adjust to return partial.

            // Let's implement partial parsing for index.
            eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    };

    // Build idx content: offsets as big-endian u64, plus count if >=1 else just [0]
    let mut idx_bytes: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
    if parsed.records.is_empty() {

    let out_path = if let Some(o) = output {
        o
    } else {
        format!("{}.idx", inp)
    };
    // Write
    match File::create(&out_path) {
        Ok(mut f) => { f.write_all(&idx_bytes).unwrap(); },
        Err(_) => { eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", out_path); std::process::exit(1); }
    }

fn split_selectors(s: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut tokens: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut cur = String::new();
    let mut in_quote = false;
    let mut i = 0;
    let bytes = s.as_bytes();
    while i < bytes.len() {
        let c = bytes[i] as char;
        if c == '"' {
            if in_quote {
                if i+1 < bytes.len() && bytes[i+1]==b'"' as u8 {
                    // escaped quote
                    cur.push('"');
                    cur.push('"');
                    i+=2;
                    continue;
                } else {
                    in_quote = false;
                    cur.push(c);
                    i+=1;
                    continue;
                }
            } else {
                in_quote = true;
                cur.push(c);
                i+=1;
                continue;
            }
        }
        if c == ',' && !in_quote {
            tokens.push(cur);
            cur = String::new();
            i+=1;
            continue;
        }
        cur.push(c);
        i+=1;
    }
    tokens.push(cur);
    tokens
}

// split range: find '-' outside quotes and outside []
fn split_range(token: &str) -> Option<(String, Option<String>)> {
    // Returns (left, Some(right)) if '-' found, where right may be empty (open-ended)
    // Returns None if no range separator
    let bytes = token.as_bytes();
    let mut in_quote = false;
    let mut in_bracket = false;
    for (i, &b) in bytes.iter().enumerate() {
        if b == b'"' {
            if in_quote {
                if i+1 < bytes.len() && bytes[i+1]==b'"' {
                    // skip escaped
                    // we need to skip next char as well? But for range detection, we can just toggle? Simpler: if in_quote and next is quote, skip both
                    // We'll handle in loop with manual index, but for simplicity, we treat "" as not closing
                    continue;
                } else {
                    in_quote = false;
                }
            } else {
                in_quote = true;
            }
        } else if b == b'[' && !in_quote {
            in_bracket = true;
        } else if b == b']' && !in_quote {
            in_bracket = false;
        } else if b == b'-' && !in_quote && !in_bracket {
            // found separator
            let left = token[..i].to_string();
            let right = token[i+1..].to_string();
            return Some((left, Some(right)));
        }
    }
    None
}

fn resolve_item(item: &str, headers: &[String], num_cols: usize, no_headers: bool) -> Vec<usize> {
    // item may be like '"a,b"' or 'a' or '1' or 'a[0]' or '"a"[1]'
    // Extract base and optional [n]
    let (base, idx_opt) = extract_bracket(item);

    // Determine if base is numeric
    let is_numeric = base.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) && !base.is_empty();

    if is_numeric {
        if idx_opt.is_some() {
            // treat as name lookup for numeric string with index -> will fail as name not found
            // So we go to name lookup path
        } else {
            // numeric index
            match base.parse::<usize>() {
                Ok(n) => {
                    if n==0 {
                        eprintln!("Selector index 0 is out of bounds. Index must be >= 1 and <= {}.", num_cols);
                        std::process::exit(1);
                    }
                    if n > num_cols {
                        eprintln!("Selector index {} is out of bounds. Index must be >= 1 and <= {}.", n, num_cols);
                        std::process::exit(1);
                    }
                    return vec![n-1];
                },
                Err(_) => {
                    // should not happen
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // Name lookup
    if no_headers {
        eprintln!("Cannot use names ('{}') in selection with --no-headers set.", base);
        std::process::exit(1);
    }

    // For name, need to handle quoted names: base may be like "\"a,b\"" or "\"a\""
    let name = if base.starts_with('"') && base.ends_with('"') && base.len()>=2 {
        // unescape double quotes: "" -> "
        let inner = &base[1..base.len()-1];
        inner.replace("\"\"", "\"")
    } else {
        base.clone()
    };

    // Find all indices where header == name
    let mut matches: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
    for (i, h) in headers.iter().enumerate() {
        if h == &name {
            matches.push(i);
        }
    }

    if matches.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("Selector name '{}' does not exist as a named header in the given CSV data.", name);
        std::process::exit(1);
    }

    if let Some(idx_str) = idx_opt {
        match idx_str.parse::<usize>() {
            Ok(n) => {
                if n >= matches.len() {
                    eprintln!("Selector index '{}' for name '{}' is out of bounds. Must be >= 0 and <= {}.", n, name, matches.len()-1);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
                return vec![matches[n]];
            },
            Err(_) => {
                eprintln!("Selector name '{}' does not exist as a named header in the given CSV data.", name);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    } else {
        // Without index, return first match? Or all? Original seems to return first only.
        // For duplicates, bare name returns first.
        return vec![matches[0]];
    }
}

fn extract_bracket(item: &str) -> (String, Option<String>) {
    // Find last '[' and check ends with ']'
    if let Some(start) = item.rfind('[') {
        if item.ends_with(']') {
            let base = item[..start].to_string();
            let idx = item[start+1..item.len()-1].to_string();
            // Ensure idx is digits only
            if idx.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
                return (base, Some(idx));
            }
        }
    }
    (item.to_string(), None)
}

Means -n has no effect, so headers are always considered? Actually for columns, headers are part of rows? Let's see: cat columns concatenates by column, so headers are also concatenated? For file a.csv with header h1,h2,h3 and 2 data rows, cat columns of a.csv with itself gives header row with double columns, and data rows doubled. So headers are treated as rows (including header) that are concatenated. So for columns, we should not skip header, we treat all records (including header) as rows to concatenate.
        // So we have each file's records (including header). Number of rows per file = records.len()
        let mut row_counts: Vec<usize> = all_data.iter().map(|p| p.records.len()).collect();
        let result_rows = if pad {
            row_counts.iter().cloned().max().unwrap_or(0)
        } else {
            row_counts.iter().cloned().min().unwrap_or(0)
        };

        for row_idx in 0..result_rows {
            let mut combined: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
            for (file_idx, parsed) in all_data.iter().enumerate() {
                if row_idx < parsed.records.len() {
                    combined.extend(parsed.records[row_idx].clone());
                } else {
                    // pad with empty fields: need number of columns of that file
                    let cols = if parsed.records.is_empty() {0} else { parsed.records[0].len() };
                    for _ in 0..cols {
                        combined.push(String::new());
                    }
                }
            }
            write_csv_record(&mut writer, &combined, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
        }
    }
}

                out_rec.truncate(max_len);
            }
            write_csv_record(&mut writer, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
        }
    } else {
        let len = length.unwrap();
        let data = read_input_bytes(input);

            Ok(p)=>p,
            Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); }
        };

                out_rec.truncate(len);
            }
            write_csv_record(&mut writer, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();

    }

        } else {

                regex_str=Some(a.clone());
            } else if input.is_none() {
                input=Some(a.clone());

        Ok(p)=>p,
        Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); }
    };

    if parsed.records.is_empty() { return; }

    let data_recs = if no_headers { parsed.records.clone() } else { parsed.records[1..].to_vec() };

    let num_cols = if no_headers {
        if parsed.records.is_empty() {0} else { parsed.records[0].len() }
    } else { headers.len() };

    // Determine columns to search
    let mut search_indices: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
    if let Some(sel_str) = select {
        // parse select similar to before
        let (invert_sel, sel_inner) = if sel_str.starts_with('!') {
            (true, sel_str[1..].to_string())
        } else {
            (false, sel_str.clone())
        };
        let mut sel_idxs: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
        if !sel_inner.is_empty() {
            let tokens = split_selectors(&sel_inner);
            for token in tokens {
                if token.is_empty() { continue; }

                    if left.is_empty() { eprintln!("Expected end of field but got '-' instead."); std::process::exit(1); }
                    let left_res = resolve_item(&left, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    let left_idx = left_res[0];
                    if let Some(right) = right_opt {
                        if right.is_empty() {
                            for idx in left_idx..num_cols { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                        } else {
                            let right_res = resolve_item(&right, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                            let right_idx = right_res[0];
                            if left_idx <= right_idx {
                                for idx in left_idx..=right_idx { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                            } else {
                                for idx in (right_idx..=left_idx).rev() { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    let mut idxs = resolve_item(&token, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    sel_idxs.append(&mut idxs);
                }
            }
        }
        if invert_sel {
            let set: HashSet<usize> = sel_idxs.into_iter().collect();
            search_indices = (0..num_cols).filter(|i| !set.contains(i)).collect();
        } else {
            search_indices = sel_idxs;
        }
    } else {
        search_indices = (0..num_cols).collect();
    }

    let mut writer = open_output(output);
    // Write header if present
    if !no_headers {
        write_csv_record(&mut writer, &headers, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
    for rec in data_recs {
        let mut matched = false;
        for &col in &search_indices {
            if col < rec.len() {
                if re.is_match(&rec[col]) {
                    matched = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        let should_output = if invert { !matched } else { matched };
        if should_output {
            write_csv_record(&mut writer, &rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
        }
    }
}

        else if a=="-s"||a=="--select" {

            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    {}", "xsv sort [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            select=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if a.starts_with("--select=") {

        } else if a.starts_with("-s") && a.len()>2 {

        } else if a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    {}", "xsv sort [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) { Ok(d)=>delimiter=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
            let val=&a[2..];
            match parse_delim(val) { Ok(d)=>delimiter=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
            let val=&a["--delimiter=".len()..];
            match parse_delim(val) { Ok(d)=>delimiter=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a=="-o"||a=="--output" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    {}", "xsv sort [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            output=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if a.starts_with("--output=") {
            output=Some(a["--output=".len()..].to_string());
        } else if a.starts_with("-o") && a.len()>2 {
            output=Some(a[2..].to_string());
        } else if a.starts_with("-") {
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    {}", a, "xsv sort [options] [<input>]");
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else {
            if input.is_some() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    {}", "xsv sort [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            input=Some(a.clone());
        }
        i+=1;
    }

    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    let data = read_input_bytes(input);
    let parsed = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) {
        Ok(p)=>p,
        Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); }
    };

    if parsed.records.is_empty() { return; }

    let headers = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed.records[0].clone() };
    let mut data_recs = if no_headers { parsed.records.clone() } else { parsed.records[1..].to_vec() };

    let num_cols = if no_headers {
        if parsed.records.is_empty() {0} else { parsed.records[0].len() }
    } else { headers.len() };

    // Determine sort columns
    let mut sort_indices: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
    if let Some(sel_str) = select {
        // parse select, handling inversion
        let (inv, inner) = if sel_str.starts_with('!') { (true, sel_str[1..].to_string()) } else { (false, sel_str.clone()) };
        let mut sel_idxs: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
        if !inner.is_empty() {
            let tokens = split_selectors(&inner);
            for token in tokens {
                if token.is_empty() { continue; }
                if let Some((left, right_opt)) = split_range(&token) {
                    if left.is_empty() { eprintln!("Expected end of field but got '-' instead."); std::process::exit(1); }
                    let left_res = resolve_item(&left, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    let left_idx = left_res[0];
                    if let Some(right) = right_opt {
                        if right.is_empty() {
                            for idx in left_idx..num_cols { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                        } else {
                            let right_res = resolve_item(&right, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                            let right_idx = right_res[0];
                            if left_idx <= right_idx {
                                for idx in left_idx..=right_idx { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                            } else {
                                for idx in (right_idx..=left_idx).rev() { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    let mut idxs = resolve_item(&token, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    sel_idxs.append(&mut idxs);
                }
            }
        }
        if inv {
            let set: HashSet<usize> = sel_idxs.into_iter().collect();
            sort_indices = (0..num_cols).filter(|i| !set.contains(i)).collect();
        } else {
            sort_indices = sel_idxs;
        }
    } else {
        sort_indices = (0..num_cols).collect();
    }

    // Sort
    data_recs.sort_by(|a,b| {
        for &col in &sort_indices {
            let av = if col < a.len() { &a[col] } else { "" };
            let bv = if col < b.len() { &b[col] } else { "" };
            let ord = if numeric {
                // compare as numbers? Try parse as f64
                let an = av.parse::<f64>();
                let bn = bv.parse::<f64>();
                if let (Ok(an), Ok(bn)) = (an, bn) {
                    an.partial_cmp(&bn).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
                } else {
                    av.cmp(bv)
                }
            } else {
                av.cmp(bv)
            };
            if ord != std::cmp::Ordering::Equal {
                return if reverse { ord.reverse() } else { ord };
            }
        }
        std::cmp::Ordering::Equal
    });

    let mut writer = open_output(output);
    if !no_headers {
        write_csv_record(&mut writer, &headers, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
    for rec in data_recs {
        write_csv_record(&mut writer, &rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
}

            match parse_delim(val) { Ok(d)=>delimiter=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a=="-o"||a=="--output" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    {}", "xsv stats [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            output=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if a.starts_with("--output=") {
            output=Some(a["--output=".len()..].to_string());
        } else if a.starts_with("-o") && a.len()>2 {
            output=Some(a[2..].to_string());
        } else if a.starts_with("-") {
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    {}", a, "xsv stats [options] [<input>]");
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else {
            if input.is_some() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    {}", "xsv stats [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            input=Some(a.clone());
        }
        i+=1;
    }

    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    if let Some(ref path) = input {
        if path!="-" {
            let idx_path = format!("{}.idx", path);
            if Path::new(&idx_path).exists() && check_stale(path) {
                eprintln!("The CSV file was modified after the index file. Please re-create the index.");
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    }
    let data = read_input_bytes(input);
    let parsed = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) {
        Ok(p)=>p,
        Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); }
    };

    if parsed.records.is_empty() {
        let mut writer = open_output(output);
        // output header for stats
        let header = if everything {
            vec!["field","type","sum","min","max","min_length","max_length","mean","stddev","median","mode","cardinality"]
        } else {
            let mut h = vec!["field","type","sum","min","max","min_length","max_length","mean","stddev"];
            if median { h.push("median"); }
            if show_mode { h.push("mode"); }
            if cardinality { h.push("cardinality"); }
            h
        };
        write_csv_record(&mut writer, &header.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
        return;
    }

    let headers = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed.records[0].clone() };
    let data_recs = if no_headers { parsed.records.clone() } else { parsed.records[1..].to_vec() };

    let num_cols = if no_headers {
        if parsed.records.is_empty() {0} else { parsed.records[0].len() }
    } else { headers.len() };

    // Determine selected columns
    let mut col_indices: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
    if let Some(sel_str) = select {
        let (inv, inner) = if sel_str.starts_with('!') { (true, sel_str[1..].to_string()) } else { (false, sel_str.clone()) };
        let mut sel_idxs: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
        if !inner.is_empty() {
            let tokens = split_selectors(&inner);
            for token in tokens {
                if token.is_empty() { continue; }
                if let Some((left, right_opt)) = split_range(&token) {
                    if left.is_empty() { eprintln!("Expected end of field but got '-' instead."); std::process::exit(1); }
                    let left_res = resolve_item(&left, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    let left_idx = left_res[0];
                    if let Some(right) = right_opt {
                        if right.is_empty() {
                            for idx in left_idx..num_cols { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                        } else {
                            let right_res = resolve_item(&right, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                            let right_idx = right_res[0];
                            if left_idx <= right_idx {
                                for idx in left_idx..=right_idx { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                            } else {
                                for idx in (right_idx..=left_idx).rev() { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    let mut idxs = resolve_item(&token, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    sel_idxs.append(&mut idxs);
                }
            }
        }
        if inv {
            let set: HashSet<usize> = sel_idxs.into_iter().collect();
            col_indices = (0..num_cols).filter(|i| !set.contains(i)).collect();
        } else {
            col_indices = sel_idxs;
        }
    } else {
        col_indices = (0..num_cols).collect();
    }

    // Compute stats per column
    // We'll need to collect values
    #[derive(Debug)]
    struct ColStats {
        values: Vec<String>,
        is_integer: bool,
        is_float: bool,
        sum: f64,
        min: Option<String>,
        max: Option<String>,
        min_len: Option<usize>,
        max_len: usize,
        count: usize, // non-null count
        total: usize, // total count including nulls if nulls flag?
        // For mean/stddev, need numeric sum
        // For median, need sorted numeric values
        // For mode, need frequency
        // For cardinality, need distinct count
    }

    let mut stats: Vec<ColStats> = Vec::new();
    for _ in 0..num_cols {
        stats.push(ColStats {
            values: Vec::new(),
            is_integer: true,
            is_float: true,
            sum: 0.0,
            min: None,
            max: None,
            min_len: None,
            max_len: 0,
            count: 0,
            total: 0,
        });
    }

    for rec in &data_recs {
        for &col in &col_indices {
            if col >= rec.len() { continue; }
            let val = &rec[col];
            let s = stats.get_mut(col).unwrap();
            s.total += 1;
            let is_null = val.is_empty();
            if is_null && !nulls {
                // do not count for mean/stddev etc? But still count for min/max? Original counts null as not included for mean/stddev but min/max etc include? Let's see: earlier stats for nulls file:
            }
            // For stats, collect values for type detection
            if !is_null {
                s.count += 1;
                s.values.push(val.clone());
                // update min/max lexicographically? For numeric columns, min/max are numeric min/max? Original stats show min/max as string? For integer column, min is numeric min as string, max numeric max.
                // We'll compute min/max as string comparison? Actually for integer, min/max numeric.
                // For simplicity, compute min/max as string comparison but also numeric if possible.
                // We'll update min/max based on lexical? For integer, lexical may not match numeric. So we need to track numeric min/max separately.

                // lengths
                let len_chars = val.chars().count();
                s.max_len = std::cmp::max(s.max_len, len_chars);
                if let Some(ml) = s.min_len {
                    s.min_len = Some(std::cmp::min(ml, len_chars));
                } else {
                    s.min_len = Some(len_chars);
                }

                // type detection: check if integer
                if s.is_integer {
                    if val.parse::<i64>().is_err() {
                        s.is_integer = false;
                    }
                }
                if s.is_float {
                    if val.parse::<f64>().is_err() {
                        s.is_float = false;
                    }
                }

                // sum for mean
                if let Ok(f) = val.parse::<f64>() {
                    s.sum += f;
                }

                // min/max
                if let Some(ref cur_min) = s.min {
                    if val < cur_min {
                        s.min = Some(val.clone());
                    }
                } else {
                    s.min = Some(val.clone());
                }
                if let Some(ref cur_max) = s.max {
                    if val > cur_max {
                        s.max = Some(val.clone());
                    }
                } else {
                    s.max = Some(val.clone());
                }
            } else {
                // null
                // For min_length etc, null has length 0?
                // In earlier stats, for column with null, min_length 0 etc.
                s.max_len = std::cmp::max(s.max_len, 0);
                if let Some(ml) = s.min_len {
                    s.min_len = Some(std::cmp::min(ml, 0));
                } else {
                    s.min_len = Some(0);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    // For output, need to produce header
    let mut header_fields: Vec<String> = vec!["field".to_string(),"type".to_string(),"sum".to_string(),"min".to_string(),"max".to_string(),"min_length".to_string(),"max_length".to_string(),"mean".to_string(),"stddev".to_string()];
    if everything {
        header_fields = vec!["field".to_string(),"type".to_string(),"sum".to_string(),"min".to_string(),"max".to_string(),"min_length".to_string(),"max_length".to_string(),"mean".to_string(),"stddev".to_string(),"median".to_string(),"mode".to_string(),"cardinality".to_string()];
    } else {
        if median { header_fields.push("median".to_string()); }
        if show_mode { header_fields.push("mode".to_string()); }
        if cardinality { header_fields.push("cardinality".to_string()); }
    }

    let mut writer = open_output(output);
    write_csv_record(&mut writer, &header_fields, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();

    for &col in &col_indices {
        let st = &stats[col];
        let field_name = if no_headers { col.to_string() } else { if col < headers.len() { headers[col].clone() } else { col.to_string() } };
        let type_str = if st.is_integer && st.count>0 { "Integer" } else if st.is_float && st.count>0 { "Float" } else { "Unicode" };
        // sum: if integer or float? Original sum for integer columns is integer sum? Example earlier sum 6 for integer column 1+2+3=6. For float? We need to output sum as string: if integer, sum as integer? But we have sum as f64, we can format: if integer, sum as integer without decimal? For 1,2,3 sum=6. For 1, int? We'll output as integer if type integer else float? For simplicity, if type integer, output sum as integer (no decimal) if sum is integer.
        let sum_str = if st.count==0 { "".to_string() } else {
            if type_str=="Integer" {
                // sum is f64 but should be integer
                format!("{}", st.sum as i64)
            } else if type_str=="Float" {
                // original shows sum as number? For float column, sum is float? In earlier mixed types, float column sum was 6? Actually for file with 2.5,3.5 etc sum 6? That was integer? Let's see earlier we had file types.csv with float column 2.5,3.5 sum 6. That's integer sum but type float. Original output sum was "6" (no decimal). So sum as integer even for float? Let's output sum as integer if it's integer value, else float.
                if st.sum.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", st.sum as i64) } else { format!("{}", st.sum) }
            } else {
                "".to_string()
            }
        };

        let min_str = st.min.clone().unwrap_or_default();
        let max_str = st.max.clone().unwrap_or_default();
        let min_len_str = st.min_len.map(|v| v.to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
        let max_len_str = st.max_len.to_string();

        // mean
        let mean_str = if st.count==0 { "".to_string() } else {
            let mean = st.sum / (if nulls { st.total as f64 } else { st.count as f64 });
            // format: original shows mean as float with maybe many decimals? For integer column 1,2,3 mean 2, original showed "2" for integer? Actually earlier stats for integer column mean was "2" for 1,2,3. For 1,2 mean 1.5. So mean may be float.
            // We'll format: if mean is integer, show as integer? Original for integer column mean 2 showed "2" not "2.0". So if mean integer, show integer? For 1.5 shows "1.5".
            // For float, show mean as float maybe with more decimals.
            // We'll format removing trailing zeros? Simpler: if mean fract 0, show as integer? But for float column mean 3, original showed "3" not "3.0". So yes.
            if mean.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", mean as i64) } else { format!("{}", mean) }
        };

        // stddev
        let stddev_str = if st.count==0 { "".to_string() } else {
            // compute stddev: need values
            let mean = st.sum / (if nulls { st.total as f64 } else { st.count as f64 });
            let mut variance = 0.0;
            let mut n = 0;
            for v in &st.values {
                if let Ok(f) = v.parse::<f64>() {
                    variance += (f - mean).powi(2);
                    n+=1;
                }
            }
            let total_n = if nulls { st.total } else { n };
            if total_n==0 { "".to_string() } else {
                let stddev = (variance / total_n as f64).sqrt();
                // format similar to original: for integer 1,2,3 stddev 0.816...
                // We'll format with default Display which may give many decimals.
                format!("{}", stddev)
            }
        };

        let mut out_rec = vec![field_name, type_str.to_string(), sum_str, min_str, max_str, min_len_str, max_len_str, mean_str, stddev_str];

        if everything {
            // median
            let median_str = if st.values.is_empty() { "".to_string() } else {
                let mut nums: Vec<f64> = st.values.iter().filter_map(|v| v.parse::<f64>().ok()).collect();
                if nums.is_empty() {
                    "".to_string()
                } else {
                    nums.sort_by(|a,b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
                    let mid = nums.len()/2;
                    if nums.len()%2==0 {
                        // average of two middle? Original median for 1,2,3 is 2, for 1,2,3,4 median would be 2.5? Let's assume average.
                        let m = (nums[mid-1]+nums[mid])/2.0;
                        if m.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", m as i64) } else { format!("{}", m) }
                    } else {
                        let m = nums[mid];
                        if m.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", m as i64) } else { format!("{}", m) }
                    }
                }
            };
            // mode: most frequent value, if tie? Original shows "N/A" if no mode? For integer column with all distinct, mode N/A. For file with duplicate? We haven't tested.
            // For simplicity, compute mode: find value with max count, if multiple with same max count and count>1, pick first? If all distinct, N/A.
            let mode_str = {
                let mut freq: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
                for v in &st.values {
                    *freq.entry(v.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1;
                }
                if freq.is_empty() {
                    "".to_string()
                } else {
                    let max_c = freq.values().cloned().max().unwrap_or(0);
                    if max_c <=1 {
                        "N/A".to_string()
                    } else {
                        // find first value with max count
                        let mut mode_val = "";
                        for v in &st.values {
                            if freq.get(v).unwrap_or(&0) == &max_c {
                                mode_val = v;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        mode_val.to_string()
                    }
                }
            };
            // cardinality: distinct count
            let card_str = {
                let mut set = HashSet::new();
                for v in &st.values { set.insert(v); }
                set.len().to_string()
            };
            out_rec.push(median_str);
            out_rec.push(mode_str);
            out_rec.push(card_str);
        } else {
            if median {
                let median_str = if st.values.is_empty() { "".to_string() } else {
                    let mut nums: Vec<f64> = st.values.iter().filter_map(|v| v.parse::<f64>().ok()).collect();
                    if nums.is_empty() { "".to_string() } else {
                        nums.sort_by(|a,b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
                        let mid = nums.len()/2;
                        if nums.len()%2==0 {
                            let m = (nums[mid-1]+nums[mid])/2.0;
                            if m.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", m as i64) } else { format!("{}", m) }
                        } else {
                            let m = nums[mid];
                            if m.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", m as i64) } else { format!("{}", m) }
                        }
                    }
                };
                out_rec.push(median_str);
            }
            if show_mode {
                let mode_str = {
                    let mut freq: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
                    for v in &st.values { *freq.entry(v.clone()).or_insert(0) += 1; }
                    if freq.is_empty() { "".to_string() } else {
                        let max_c = freq.values().cloned().max().unwrap_or(0);
                        if max_c <=1 { "N/A".to_string() } else {
                            let mut mode_val = "";
                            for v in &st.values {
                                if freq.get(v).unwrap_or(&0) == &max_c {
                                    mode_val = v;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            mode_val.to_string()
                        }
                    }
                };
                out_rec.push(mode_str);
            }
            if cardinality {
                let mut set = HashSet::new();
                for v in &st.values { set.insert(v); }
                out_rec.push(set.len().to_string());
            }
        }

        write_csv_record(&mut writer, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
}

fn parse_join_columns(sel_str: &str, headers: &[String], num_cols: usize, no_headers: bool) -> Vec<usize> {
    // Similar to select parsing but without inversion and without open-ended? Actually join columns can be ranges? The help says columns can be referenced by name or index, range with '-'.
    // We'll parse using same split and range logic as select, but no invert.

    let mut result: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
    let tokens = split_selectors(sel_str);
    for token in tokens {
        if token.is_empty() { continue; }
        if let Some((left, right_opt)) = split_range(&token) {
            if left.is_empty() { eprintln!("Expected end of field but got '-' instead."); std::process::exit(1); }
            let left_res = resolve_item(&left, headers, num_cols, no_headers);
            let left_idx = left_res[0];
            if let Some(right) = right_opt {
                if right.is_empty() {
                    for idx in left_idx..num_cols { result.push(idx); }
                } else {
                    let right_res = resolve_item(&right, headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    let right_idx = right_res[0];
                    if left_idx <= right_idx {
                        for idx in left_idx..=right_idx { result.push(idx); }
                    } else {
                        for idx in (right_idx..=left_idx).rev() { result.push(idx); }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            let mut idxs = resolve_item(&token, headers, num_cols, no_headers);
            result.append(&mut idxs);
        }
    }
    result
}

        let mut idxs = parse_join_columns(&col_str, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
        if idxs.is_empty() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    {}", "xsv partition [options] <column> <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv partition --help"); std::process::exit(1); }

    };

        eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", outdir_str);

    });

    struct PartWriter {

    }

    let mut writers: HashMap<String, PartWriter> = HashMap::new();

    for rec in data_recs {
        if col_idx >= rec.len() { continue; }
        let mut part_val = rec[col_idx].clone();
        if let Some(pl) = prefix_len {
            if part_val.len() > pl {
                part_val = part_val[..pl].to_string();
            }
        }

        // sanitize for shell safety: replace non-alphanumeric with underscore? Original says sanitized for shell safety.
        // Let's implement simple sanitization: keep alphanumeric, dash, underscore, dot, replace others with underscore.
        // Also need to handle empty?
        let sanitized = sanitize_filename(&part_val);

        // Determine filename
        let filename = filename_template.replace("{}", &key);
        let full_path = Path::new(&outdir_str).join(&filename);

        // Get writer or create
        if !writers.contains_key(&key) {
            let file = File::create(&full_path).unwrap();
            let mut w = BufWriter::new(file);
            if !no_headers {
                let mut out_header = Vec::new();
                for (i, h) in headers.iter().enumerate() {
                    if drop && i==col_idx { continue; }
                    out_header.push(h.clone());
                }
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_header, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
            writers.insert(key.clone(), PartWriter { writer: w });
        }

        let pw = writers.get_mut(&key).unwrap();
        let mut out_rec: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        for (i, field) in rec.iter().enumerate() {
            if drop && i==col_idx { continue; }
            out_rec.push(field.clone());
        }

}

fn sanitize_filename(s: &str) -> String {
    if s.is_empty() {
        return "empty".to_string(); //? Not sure
    }
    let mut out = String::new();
    for ch in s.chars() {
        if ch.is_alphanumeric() || ch=='-' || ch=='_' || ch=='.' {
            out.push(ch);
        } else {
            out.push('_');
        }
    }
    out
}

// CSV config

#[derive(Clone)]
struct CsvConfig {
    delimiter: u8,
    quote: u8,
    escape: Option<u8>,
    quoting: bool,
}

fn parse_delim(s: &str) -> Result<u8, String> {
    if s.chars().count() != 1 {
        return Err(format!("Could not convert '{}' to a single ASCII character.", s));
    }
    let b = s.as_bytes()[0];
    if b > 127 {
        return Err(format!("Could not convert '{}' to a single ASCII character.", s));
    }
    Ok(b)
}

fn read_input_bytes(input: Option<String>) -> Vec<u8> {
    if let Some(p) = input {
        if p == "-" {
            let mut buf = Vec::new();
            io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut buf).unwrap();
            buf
        } else {
            match std::fs::read(&p) {
                Ok(b) => b,
                Err(_) => { eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", p); std::process::exit(1); }
            }
        }
    } else {
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut buf).unwrap();
        buf
    }
}

fn open_output(path: Option<String>) -> Box<dyn Write> {
    if let Some(p) = path {
        match File::create(&p) {
            Ok(f) => Box::new(BufWriter::new(f)),
            Err(_) => { eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", p); std::process::exit(1); }
        }
    } else {
        Box::new(BufWriter::new(io::stdout()))
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct ParsedCsv {
    records: Vec<Vec<String>>,
    offsets: Vec<u64>,
}

fn parse_csv_with_blank_handling(data: &[u8], cfg: &CsvConfig) -> Result<ParsedCsv, String> {
    let mut records: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::new();
    let mut offsets: Vec<u64> = Vec::new();
    let mut idx = 0usize;
    let len = data.len();
    let mut pending_blank_start: Option<usize> = None;
    let mut first_len: Option<usize> = None;
    let mut non_blank_line_no: usize = 0; // counts non-blank records for line numbers

    while idx < len {
        // blank line detection: 0 bytes before newline
        if data[idx] == b'\n' {
            if pending_blank_start.is_none() { pending_blank_start = Some(idx); }
            idx+=1;
            continue;
        }
        if data[idx]==b'\r' {
            if idx+1 < len && data[idx+1]==b'\n' {
                // "\r\n" blank line?
                if pending_blank_start.is_none() { pending_blank_start = Some(idx); }
                idx+=2;
                continue;
            } else {
                if pending_blank_start.is_none() { pending_blank_start = Some(idx); }
                idx+=1;
                continue;
            }
        }

        // not blank at idx, parse one CSV record starting at idx
        let rec_offset = pending_blank_start.unwrap_or(idx) as u64;
        let mut field_buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
        let mut rec_fields: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        let mut in_quote = false;
        let mut at_field_start = true;
        let mut p = idx;

        while p < len {
            let c = data[p];
            if in_quote {
                if let Some(esc) = cfg.escape {
                    if c==esc {
                        if p+1 < len {
                            field_buf.push(data[p+1]);
                            p+=2;
                            at_field_start=false;
                            continue;
                        } else {
                            field_buf.push(c);
                            p+=1;
                            at_field_start=false;
                            continue;
                        }
                    } else if c==cfg.quote {
                        if cfg.escape.is_none() {
                            if p+1 < len && data[p+1]==cfg.quote {
                                field_buf.push(cfg.quote);
                                p+=2;
                                at_field_start=false;
                                continue;
                            } else {
                                in_quote=false;
                                p+=1;
                                at_field_start=false;
                                continue;
                            }
                        } else {
                            in_quote=false;
                            p+=1;
                            at_field_start=false;
                            continue;
                        }
                    } else {
                        field_buf.push(c);
                        p+=1;
                        at_field_start=false;
                        continue;
                    }
                } else {
                    if c==cfg.quote {
                        if p+1 < len && data[p+1]==cfg.quote {
                            field_buf.push(cfg.quote);
                            p+=2;
                            at_field_start=false;
                            continue;
                        } else {
                            in_quote=false;
                            p+=1;
                            at_field_start=false;
                            continue;
                        }
                    } else {
                        field_buf.push(c);
                        p+=1;
                        at_field_start=false;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if cfg.quoting && at_field_start && c==cfg.quote {
                    in_quote=true;
                    p+=1;
                    at_field_start=false;
                    continue;
                }
                if c==cfg.delimiter {
                    rec_fields.push(String::from_utf8_lossy(&field_buf).into_owned());
                    field_buf.clear();
                    at_field_start=true;
                    p+=1;
                    continue;
                }
                if c==b'\n' {
                    rec_fields.push(String::from_utf8_lossy(&field_buf).into_owned());
                    field_buf.clear();
                    p+=1;
                    break;
                }
                if c==b'\r' {
                    rec_fields.push(String::from_utf8_lossy(&field_buf).into_owned());
                    field_buf.clear();
                    p+=1;
                    if p < len && data[p]==b'\n' { p+=1; }
                    break;
                }
                field_buf.push(c);
                p+=1;
                at_field_start=false;
            }
        }

        // EOF without newline: push pending field
        if p>=len && (!field_buf.is_empty() || !rec_fields.is_empty() || at_field_start==false) {
            // If we have not yet pushed last field (because no delimiter newline)
            // Check if we already pushed due to loop break? For EOF case, we didn't push last field yet if we exited via p==len without hitting newline
            // In our loop above, when we hit EOF, we break out of inner while without pushing? Actually we only push on delimiter or newline. At EOF, field_buf may contain data.
            // So push it
            if !field_buf.is_empty() || at_field_start==true {
                // If at_field_start true and field_buf empty, we might have trailing delimiter? For simplicity, if rec_fields is not empty and we are at EOF after delimiter, we already have field? Actually trailing delimiter case: "a,b," -> fields: a,b,"" . Our logic: when delimiter encountered, we push field and clear. At end, field_buf empty, but we need to push empty field for trailing delimiter. How to detect trailing delimiter? If last char was delimiter, then at_field_start would be true and rec_fields would have one less than expected. So we should push empty field if last char was delimiter.
                // For now, handle: if p==len and (data[len-1]==cfg.delimiter) then need empty field
                // Simpler: if we have field_buf not empty or at_field_start and rec_fields not empty, push
            }
            // If we still have field_buf, push
            if !field_buf.is_empty() || (idx>0 && data[idx-1]==cfg.delimiter) || rec_fields.is_empty() {
                // Actually for safety, if we have not yet pushed field_buf, push it if we are in non-blank record
                // For record like "a,b" without newline, after loop p==len, field_buf contains "b", rec_fields contains ["a"], so we need to push "b"
                if field_buf.is_empty() && rec_fields.is_empty() {
                    // nothing
                } else {
                    if !field_buf.is_empty() || at_field_start {
                        // If at_field_start true after delimiter, field_buf empty but we need empty field
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // The above logic for EOF is messy; let's re-evaluate: our inner loop breaks on newline, pushing field before break. At EOF, it exits without pushing? In our outer while we have p pointing after record? For EOF, p==len and we have field_buf and rec_fields partially. We need to push final field.

        // Actually we have two cases:
        // - If we broke due to newline, we already pushed field and rec_fields is complete.
        // - If we exited because p==len, we have field_buf containing last field not yet pushed, and rec_fields containing previous fields.

        // Let's handle: if p>=len and (field_buf not empty or rec_fields not empty) and final record not yet pushed via break, push field_buf then rec.

        // To simplify, we will after inner loop, if field_buf not empty or rec_fields not empty and we didn't already have complete record via newline break, push.

        // For our implementation, when we break via newline, we pushed field and broke, so rec_fields is complete and field_buf empty.
        // When we exit via p==len, field_buf may have last field.
        if p>=len {
            if !field_buf.is_empty() || !rec_fields.is_empty() {
                if !field_buf.is_empty() || rec_fields.len()>0 {
                    // If field_buf empty but we are after delimiter? Might need empty field. For simplicity, push field_buf as string (could be empty)
                    if at_field_start && field_buf.is_empty() && !rec_fields.is_empty() {
                        // trailing empty field due to delimiter at end? Actually if file ends with delimiter, field_buf empty and at_field_start true, we should push empty?
                        // Example "a,b," -> after parsing "a" delimiter, field pushed, then "b" delimiter, field pushed, then at field start, field_buf empty, p==len, we should push empty field.
                        rec_fields.push(String::new());
                    } else {
                        if !field_buf.is_empty() || !rec_fields.is_empty() {
                            let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&field_buf).into_owned();
                            // Only push if not already pushed? For EOF, we have not pushed last field yet.
                            // Check if we have field_buf that wasn't pushed: if we have rec_fields already containing some fields and field_buf contains last field, push.
                            // If rec_fields already has complete record via newline break, field_buf would be empty and we would not be here.
                            rec_fields.push(s);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Now rec_fields should be the record
        if rec_fields.is_empty() {
            // Should be blank, but we already filtered blank at start, so this could be empty due to parsing error?
            idx = p;
            continue;
        }

        // Check unequal lengths
        non_blank_line_no+=1;
        if let Some(fl) = first_len {
            if rec_fields.len() != fl {
                let rec_no = non_blank_line_no - 1;
                let line_no = non_blank_line_no;
                let byte_off = rec_offset;
                return Err(format!("record {} (line: {}, byte: {}): found record with {} fields, but the previous record has {} fields", rec_no, line_no, byte_off, rec_fields.len(), fl));
            }
        } else {
            first_len = Some(rec_fields.len());
        }

        records.push(rec_fields);
        offsets.push(rec_offset);
        pending_blank_start = None;
        idx = p;
    }

    Ok(ParsedCsv { records, offsets })
}

fn write_csv_record<W: Write>(writer: &mut W, fields: &[String], out_delim: u8, quote: u8, quote_always: bool, escape: Option<u8>, crlf: bool, ascii: bool) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let field_sep = if ascii { 0x1Fu8 } else { out_delim };
    let rec_sep = if ascii { 0x1Eu8 } else { b'\n' };
    for (i, f) in fields.iter().enumerate() {
        if i>0 { writer.write_all(&[field_sep])?; }
        let need_quote = if quote_always {
            true
        } else {
            let bytes = f.as_bytes();
            let mut need = false;
            for &b in bytes {
                if b==field_sep || b==rec_sep || b==quote || b==b'\n' || b==b'\r' { need=true; break; }
                if !ascii && b==out_delim { need=true; break; }
            }
            need
        };
        if need_quote {
            writer.write_all(&[quote])?;
            for &b in f.as_bytes() {
                if b==quote {
                    if let Some(esc) = escape {
                        writer.write_all(&[esc])?;
                        writer.write_all(&[quote])?;
                    } else {
                        writer.write_all(&[quote, quote])?;
                    }
                } else {
                    writer.write_all(&[b])?;
                }
            }
            writer.write_all(&[quote])?;
        } else {
            writer.write_all(f.as_bytes())?;
        }
    }
    if crlf && !ascii {
        writer.write_all(b"\r\n")?;
    } else {
        writer.write_all(&[rec_sep])?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn check_stale(csv_path: &str) -> bool {
    let idx_path = format!("{}.idx", csv_path);
    let csv_meta = std::fs::metadata(csv_path);
    let idx_meta = std::fs::metadata(&idx_path);
    if let (Ok(c), Ok(i)) = (csv_meta, idx_meta) {
        if let (Ok(c_time), Ok(i_time)) = (c.modified(), i.modified()) {
            if let (Ok(c_dur), Ok(i_dur)) = (c_time.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH), i_time.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)) {
                if c_dur.as_secs() > i_dur.as_secs() { return true; }
            }
        }
    }
    false
}

fn read_index(csv_path: &str) -> Option<(Vec<u64>, u64)> {
    let idx_path = format!("{}.idx", csv_path);
    let data = std::fs::read(&idx_path).ok()?;
    if data.len()%8!=0 { return None; }
    let mut vals = Vec::new();
    for chunk in data.chunks(8) {
        let mut arr=[0u8;8];
        arr.copy_from_slice(chunk);
        vals.push(u64::from_be_bytes(arr));
    }
    if vals.is_empty() { return None; }
    if vals.len()==1 {
        Some((vec![0], 0))
    } else {
        let count = *vals.last().unwrap();
        let offs = vals[..vals.len()-1].to_vec();
        Some((offs, count))
    }
}

// select helpers

fn split_selectors(s: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut tokens = Vec::new();
    let mut cur = String::new();
    let mut in_q = false;
    let bytes = s.as_bytes();
    let mut i=0;
    while i<bytes.len() {
        let c = bytes[i];
        if c==b'"' {
            if in_q {
                if i+1 < bytes.len() && bytes[i+1]==b'"' {
                    cur.push('"');
                    cur.push('"');
                    i+=2;
                    continue;
                } else {
                    in_q=false;
                    cur.push(c as char);
                    i+=1;
                    continue;
                }
            } else {
                in_q=true;
                cur.push(c as char);
                i+=1;
                continue;
            }
        }
        if c==b',' && !in_q {
            tokens.push(cur);
            cur=String::new();
            i+=1;
            continue;
        }
        cur.push(c as char);
        i+=1;
    }
    tokens.push(cur);
    tokens
}

fn split_range(token: &str) -> Option<(String, Option<String>)> {
    let bytes = token.as_bytes();
    let mut in_q = false;
    let mut in_brack = false;
    for (i,&b) in bytes.iter().enumerate() {
        if b==b'"' {
            if in_q {
                if i+1 < bytes.len() && bytes[i+1]==b'"' {
                    continue;
                } else { in_q=false; }
            } else { in_q=true; }
        } else if b==b'[' && !in_q { in_brack=true; }
        else if b==b']' && !in_q { in_brack=false; }
        else if b==b'-' && !in_q && !in_brack {
            let left = token[..i].to_string();
            let right = token[i+1..].to_string();
            return Some((left, Some(right)));
        }
    }
    None
}

fn extract_bracket(item: &str) -> (String, Option<String>) {
    if let Some(st)=item.rfind('[') {
        if item.ends_with(']') {
            let base=item[..st].to_string();
            let idx=item[st+1..item.len()-1].to_string();
            if idx.chars().all(|c|c.is_ascii_digit()) {
                return (base, Some(idx));
            }
        }
    }
    (item.to_string(), None)
}

fn resolve_item(item: &str, headers: &[String], num_cols: usize, no_headers: bool) -> Vec<usize> {
    let (base, idx_opt) = extract_bracket(item);
    let is_numeric = !base.is_empty() && base.chars().all(|c|c.is_ascii_digit());
    if is_numeric && idx_opt.is_none() {
        match base.parse::<usize>() {
            Ok(n)=>{
                if n==0 {
                    eprintln!("Selector index 0 is out of bounds. Index must be >= 1 and <= {}.", num_cols);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
                if n>num_cols {
                    eprintln!("Selector index {} is out of bounds. Index must be >= 1 and <= {}.", n, num_cols);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
                return vec![n-1];
            },
            Err(_)=>{},
        }
    }
    if no_headers {
        eprintln!("Cannot use names ('{}') in selection with --no-headers set.", base);
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let name = if base.starts_with('"') && base.ends_with('"') && base.len()>=2 {
        base[1..base.len()-1].replace("\"\"", "\"")
    } else {
        base.clone()
    };
    let mut matches = Vec::new();
    for (i,h) in headers.iter().enumerate() {
        if h==&name { matches.push(i); }
    }
    if matches.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("Selector name '{}' does not exist as a named header in the given CSV data.", name);
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    if let Some(idx_str)=idx_opt {
        match idx_str.parse::<usize>() {
            Ok(n)=>{
                if n>=matches.len() {
                    eprintln!("Selector index '{}' for name '{}' is out of bounds. Must be >= 0 and <= {}.", n, name, matches.len()-1);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
                return vec![matches[n]];
            },
            Err(_)=>{
                eprintln!("Selector name '{}' does not exist as a named header in the given CSV data.", name);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    } else {
        return vec![matches[0]];
    }
}

fn parse_join_columns(sel_str: &str, headers: &[String], num_cols: usize, no_headers: bool) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut result = Vec::new();
    let tokens = split_selectors(sel_str);
    for token in tokens {
        if token.is_empty() { continue; }
        if let Some((left, right_opt)) = split_range(&token) {
            if left.is_empty() { eprintln!("Expected end of field but got '-' instead."); std::process::exit(1); }
            let left_res = resolve_item(&left, headers, num_cols, no_headers);
            let left_idx = left_res[0];
            if let Some(right) = right_opt {
                if right.is_empty() {
                    for idx in left_idx..num_cols { result.push(idx); }
                } else {
                    let right_res = resolve_item(&right, headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    let right_idx = right_res[0];
                    if left_idx <= right_idx {
                        for idx in left_idx..=right_idx { result.push(idx); }
                    } else {
                        for idx in (right_idx..=left_idx).rev() { result.push(idx); }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            let mut idxs = resolve_item(&token, headers, num_cols, no_headers);
            result.append(&mut idxs);
        }
    }
    result
}

fn sanitize_filename(s: &str) -> String {
    if s.is_empty() { return "empty".to_string(); }
    let mut out = String::new();
    for ch in s.chars() {
        if ch.is_alphanumeric() || ch=='-' || ch=='_' || ch=='.' { out.push(ch); } else { out.push('_'); }
    }
    out
}

fn cmd_headers(args: &[String]) {
    let mut delim = b',';
    let mut just = false;
    let mut inter = false;
    let mut inputs: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut i=0;
    while i<args.len() {
        let a=&args[i];
        if a=="-h"||a=="--help" { print!("{}", get_help("headers").unwrap()); return; }
        else if a=="-j"||a=="--just-names" { just=true; }
        else if a=="--intersect" { inter=true; }
        else if a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv headers [options] [<input>...]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
            match parse_delim(&a[2..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
            match parse_delim(&a["--delimiter=".len()..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-") {
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    xsv headers [options] [<input>...]", a);
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else {
            inputs.push(a.clone());
        }
        i+=1;
    }
    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter: delim, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    if inputs.is_empty() {
        let data = read_input_bytes(None);
        match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) {
            Ok(parsed) => {
                if parsed.records.is_empty() { return; }
                let hdr = &parsed.records[0];
                if just {
                    for h in hdr { println!("{}", h); }
                } else {
                    for (idx,h) in hdr.iter().enumerate() { println!("{}\t{}", idx+1, h); }
                }
            },
            Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); }
        }
        return;
    }
    let mut all_hdrs: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::new();
    for p in &inputs {
        let data = if p=="-" {
            let mut buf=Vec::new(); io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut buf).unwrap(); buf
        } else {
            match std::fs::read(p) { Ok(b)=>b, Err(_)=>{ eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", p); std::process::exit(1); } }
        };
        match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) {
            Ok(parsed) => {
                if parsed.records.is_empty() { all_hdrs.push(vec![]); } else { all_hdrs.push(parsed.records[0].clone()); }
            },
            Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); }
        }
    }
    if inter {
        if all_hdrs.is_empty() { return; }
        let first = &all_hdrs[0];
        let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        let mut res = Vec::new();
        for h in first {
            if seen.contains(h) { continue; }
            let mut ok=true;
            for other in all_hdrs.iter().skip(1) {
                if !other.contains(h) { ok=false; break; }
            }
            if ok { seen.insert(h.clone()); res.push(h.clone()); }
        }
        for h in res { println!("{}", h); }
    } else {
        if inputs.len()>1 {
            for hdr in all_hdrs { for h in hdr { println!("{}", h); } }
        } else {
            let hdr = &all_hdrs[0];
            if just {
                for h in hdr { println!("{}", h); }
            } else {
                for (idx,h) in hdr.iter().enumerate() { println!("{}\t{}", idx+1, h); }
            }
        }
    }
}

        } else {

            input=Some(a.clone());
        }
        i+=1;
    }

fn cmd_select(args: &[String]) {
    let mut delim = b',';
    let mut out: Option<String> = None;
    let mut no_headers = false;
    let mut sel: Option<String> = None;
    let mut input: Option<String> = None;
    let mut after_dd = false;
    let mut i=0;
    while i<args.len() {
        let a=&args[i];
        if !after_dd && a=="--" { after_dd=true; i+=1; continue; }
        if !after_dd && (a=="-h"||a=="--help") { print!("{}", get_help("select").unwrap()); return; }
        else if !after_dd && (a=="-n"||a=="--no-headers") { no_headers=true; }
        else if !after_dd && (a=="-o"||a=="--output") {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv select [options] [--] <selection> [<input>]\n    xsv select --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            out=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if !after_dd && a.starts_with("--output=") { out=Some(a["--output=".len()..].to_string()); }
        else if !after_dd && a.starts_with("-o") && a.len()>2 { out=Some(a[2..].to_string()); }
        else if !after_dd && (a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter") {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv select [options] [--] <selection> [<input>]\n    xsv select --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if !after_dd && a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
            match parse_delim(&a[2..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if !after_dd && a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
            match parse_delim(&a["--delimiter=".len()..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if !after_dd && a.starts_with("-") && a.len()>1 {
            // unknown flag
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    xsv select [options] [--] <selection> [<input>]\n    xsv select --help", a);
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else {
            if sel.is_none() { sel=Some(a.clone()); }
            else if input.is_none() { input=Some(a.clone()); }
            else { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv select [options] [--] <selection> [<input>]\n    xsv select --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
        }
        i+=1;
    }
    if sel.is_none() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv select [options] [--] <selection> [<input>]\n    xsv select --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
    let sel_str = sel.unwrap();

    // unclosed quote check
    if sel_str.contains('"') {
        let mut in_q = false;
        let bytes = sel_str.as_bytes();
        let mut j=0;
        while j<bytes.len() {
            if bytes[j]==b'"' {
                if in_q {
                    if j+1 < bytes.len() && bytes[j+1]==b'"' { j+=2; continue; } else { in_q=false; }
                } else { in_q=true; }
            }
            j+=1;
        }
        if in_q { eprintln!("Unclosed quote, missing closing \"."); std::process::exit(1); }
    }

    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter: delim, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    let data = read_input_bytes(input);
    let parsed = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) {
        Ok(p)=>p,
        Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); }
    };
    if parsed.records.is_empty() { return; }
    let headers = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed.records[0].clone() };
    let data_recs = if no_headers { parsed.records.clone() } else { parsed.records[1..].to_vec() };
    let num_cols = if no_headers { parsed.records[0].len() } else { headers.len() };

    let mut invert = false;
    let mut sel_inner = sel_str.clone();
    if sel_inner.starts_with('!') { invert=true; sel_inner=sel_inner[1..].to_string(); }

    let mut selected: Vec<usize> = Vec::new();
    if !sel_inner.is_empty() {
        let tokens = split_selectors(&sel_inner);
        for token in tokens {
            if token.is_empty() { continue; }
            if let Some((left, right_opt)) = split_range(&token) {
                if left.is_empty() { eprintln!("Expected end of field but got '-' instead."); std::process::exit(1); }
                let left_res = resolve_item(&left, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                let left_idx = left_res[0];
                if let Some(right) = right_opt {
                    if right.is_empty() {
                        for idx in left_idx..num_cols { selected.push(idx); }
                    } else {
                        let right_res = resolve_item(&right, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                        let right_idx = right_res[0];
                        if left_idx <= right_idx {
                            for idx in left_idx..=right_idx { selected.push(idx); }
                        } else {
                            for idx in (right_idx..=left_idx).rev() { selected.push(idx); }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                let mut idxs = resolve_item(&token, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                selected.append(&mut idxs);
            }
        }
    }

    let final_indices = if invert {
        let set: HashSet<usize> = selected.into_iter().collect();
        (0..num_cols).filter(|i| !set.contains(i)).collect::<Vec<_>>()
    } else { selected };

    let mut out_recs: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::new();
    if !no_headers {
        let mut hdr = Vec::new();
        for &idx in &final_indices { if idx < headers.len() { hdr.push(headers[idx].clone()); } else { hdr.push(String::new()); } }
        out_recs.push(hdr);
    }
    for rec in data_recs {
        let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
        for &idx in &final_indices { if idx < rec.len() { out_rec.push(rec[idx].clone()); } else { out_rec.push(String::new()); } }
        out_recs.push(out_rec);
    }

    let mut writer = open_output(out);
    for rec in out_recs { write_csv_record(&mut writer, &rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap(); }
}
