fn cmd_cat(args: &[String]) {
    if args.is_empty() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv cat rows    [options] [<input>...]\n    xsv cat columns [options] [<input>...]\n    xsv cat --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
    if args[0]=="-h"||args[0]=="--help" { print!("{}", get_help("cat").unwrap()); return; }
    let sub = args[0].clone();
    if sub!="rows" && sub!="columns" { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv cat rows    [options] [<input>...]\n    xsv cat columns [options] [<input>...]\n    xsv cat --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
    let is_rows = sub=="rows";
    let mut delim = b',';
    let mut out: Option<String> = None;
    let mut no_headers = false;
    let mut pad = false;
    let mut inputs: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut i=1;
    while i<args.len() {
        let a=&args[i];
        if a=="-h"||a=="--help" { print!("{}", get_help("cat").unwrap()); return; }
        else if a=="-p"||a=="--pad" { pad=true; }
        else if a=="-n"||a=="--no-headers" { no_headers=true; }
        else if a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv cat rows    [options] [<input>...]\n    xsv cat columns [options] [<input>...]\n    xsv cat --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
            match parse_delim(&a[2..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
            match parse_delim(&a["--delimiter=".len()..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a=="-o"||a=="--output" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv cat rows    [options] [<input>...]\n    xsv cat columns [options] [<input>...]\n    xsv cat --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            out=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if a.starts_with("--output=") { out=Some(a["--output=".len()..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-o") && a.len()>2 { out=Some(a[2..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-") {
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    xsv cat rows    [options] [<input>...]\n    xsv cat columns [options] [<input>...]\n    xsv cat --help", a);
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else { inputs.push(a.clone()); }
        i+=1;
    }
    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter: delim, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    let mut all: Vec<ParsedCsv> = Vec::new();
    if inputs.is_empty() {
        let data = read_input_bytes(None);
        match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) { Ok(p)=>all.push(p), Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } }
    } else {
        for p in &inputs {
            let data = if p=="-" { let mut buf=Vec::new(); io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut buf).unwrap(); buf } else { match std::fs::read(p) { Ok(b)=>b, Err(_)=>{ eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", p); std::process::exit(1); } } };
            match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) { Ok(parsed)=>all.push(parsed), Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } }
        }
    }
    let mut writer = open_output(out);
    if is_rows {
        if all.is_empty() { return; }
        let num_cols = if all[0].records.is_empty() {0} else { all[0].records[0].len() };
        if !no_headers {
            if !all[0].records.is_empty() {
                write_csv_record(&mut writer, &all[0].records[0], b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
        }
        for (fi, parsed) in all.iter().enumerate() {
            let start = if fi==0 { if no_headers {0} else {1} } else { if no_headers {0} else {1} };
            for rec in parsed.records.iter().skip(start) {
                if rec.len()!=num_cols { eprintln!("CSV error: found record with {} fields, but the previous record has {} fields", rec.len(), num_cols); std::process::exit(1); }
                write_csv_record(&mut writer, rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
        }
    } else {
        if all.is_empty() { return; }
        let max_rows = if pad { all.iter().map(|p| p.records.len()).max().unwrap_or(0) } else { all.iter().map(|p| p.records.len()).min().unwrap_or(0) };
        for r in 0..max_rows {
            let mut combined = Vec::new();
            for parsed in &all {
                if r < parsed.records.len() {
                    combined.extend(parsed.records[r].clone());
                } else {
                    let cols = if parsed.records.is_empty() {0} else { parsed.records[0].len() };
                    for _ in 0..cols { combined.push(String::new()); }
                }
            }
            write_csv_record(&mut writer, &combined, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
        }
    }
}

    }

    if let Some(ref p) = input { if p!="-" { let ip=format!("{}.idx", p); if Path::new(&ip).exists() && check_stale(p) { eprintln!("The CSV file was modified after the index file. Please re-create the index."); std::process::exit(1); } } }
    let data = read_input_bytes(input);
    let parsed = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) { Ok(p)=>p, Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } };
    if parsed.records.is_empty() {
        let mut w = open_output(out);
        write_csv_record(&mut w, &vec!["field".to_string(),"value".to_string(),"count".to_string()], b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
        return;
    }
    let headers = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed.records[0].clone() };
    let data_recs = if no_headers { parsed.records.clone() } else { parsed.records[1..].to_vec() };
    let num_cols = if no_headers { parsed.records[0].len() } else { headers.len() };
    let mut col_idxs = Vec::new();
    if let Some(sel_str)=select {
        let (inv, inner) = if sel_str.starts_with('!') { (true, sel_str[1..].to_string()) } else { (false, sel_str.clone()) };
        let mut sel_idxs = Vec::new();
        if !inner.is_empty() {
            let toks = split_selectors(&inner);
            for tok in toks {
                if tok.is_empty() { continue; }
                if let Some((l, r_opt)) = split_range(&tok) {
                    if l.is_empty() { eprintln!("Expected end of field but got '-' instead."); std::process::exit(1); }
                    let lr = resolve_item(&l, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    let li = lr[0];
                    if let Some(r) = r_opt {
                        if r.is_empty() {
                            for idx in li..num_cols { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                        } else {
                            let rr = resolve_item(&r, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                            let ri = rr[0];
                            if li <= ri { for idx in li..=ri { sel_idxs.push(idx); } } else { for idx in (ri..=li).rev() { sel_idxs.push(idx); } }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    let mut ids = resolve_item(&tok, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    sel_idxs.append(&mut ids);
                }
            }
        }
        if inv {
            let set: HashSet<usize> = sel_idxs.into_iter().collect();
            col_idxs = (0..num_cols).filter(|i| !set.contains(i)).collect();
        } else { col_idxs = sel_idxs; }
    } else {
        col_idxs = (0..num_cols).collect();
    }
    let mut freq_maps: Vec<HashMap<String, usize>> = vec![HashMap::new(); num_cols];
    for rec in &data_recs {
        for &actual in &col_idxs {
            if actual >= rec.len() { continue; }
            let val = rec[actual].clone();
            if no_nulls && val.is_empty() { continue; }
            let key = if val.is_empty() { "(NULL)".to_string() } else { val };
            *freq_maps[actual].entry(key).or_insert(0) += 1;
        }
    }
    let mut out_recs: Vec<(String, String, usize)> = Vec::new();
    for &actual in &col_idxs {
        let field_name = if no_headers { actual.to_string() } else { if actual < headers.len() { headers[actual].clone() } else { actual.to_string() } };
        let map = &freq_maps[actual];
        let mut items: Vec<(&String, &usize)> = map.iter().collect();
        if asc {
            items.sort_by(|a,b| a.1.cmp(b.1).then(a.0.cmp(b.0)));
        } else {
            items.sort_by(|a,b| b.1.cmp(a.1).then(a.0.cmp(b.0)));
        }
        let lim = if limit==0 { items.len() } else { std::cmp::min(limit, items.len()) };
        for (v,c) in items.into_iter().take(lim) {
            out_recs.push((field_name.clone(), v.clone(), *c));
        }
    }
    let mut w = open_output(out);
    write_csv_record(&mut w, &vec!["field".to_string(),"value".to_string(),"count".to_string()], b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    for (f,v,c) in out_recs {
        write_csv_record(&mut w, &vec![f,v,c.to_string()], b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
}

fn cmd_search(args: &[String]) {
    let mut delim = b',';
    let mut out: Option<String> = None;
    let mut no_headers = false;
    let mut ignore_case = false;
    let mut sel: Option<String> = None;
    let mut invert = false;
    let mut regex_str: Option<String> = None;
    let mut input: Option<String> = None;
    let mut i=0;
    while i<args.len() {
        let a=&args[i];
        if a=="-h"||a=="--help" { print!("{}", get_help("search").unwrap()); return; }
        else if a=="-n"||a=="--no-headers" { no_headers=true; }
        else if a=="-i"||a=="--ignore-case" { ignore_case=true; }
        else if a=="-v"||a=="--invert-match" { invert=true; }
        else if a=="-s"||a=="--select" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv search [options] <regex> [<input>]\n    xsv search --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            sel=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if a.starts_with("--select=") { sel=Some(a["--select=".len()..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-s") && a.len()>2 { sel=Some(a[2..].to_string()); }
        else if a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv search [options] <regex> [<input>]\n    xsv search --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
            match parse_delim(&a[2..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
            match parse_delim(&a["--delimiter=".len()..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a=="-o"||a=="--output" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv search [options] <regex> [<input>]\n    xsv search --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            out=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if a.starts_with("--output=") { out=Some(a["--output=".len()..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-o") && a.len()>2 { out=Some(a[2..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-") {
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    xsv search [options] <regex> [<input>]\n    xsv search --help", a);
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else {
            if regex_str.is_none() { regex_str=Some(a.clone()); }
            else if input.is_none() { input=Some(a.clone()); }
            else { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv search [options] <regex> [<input>]\n    xsv search --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
        }
        i+=1;
    }
    if regex_str.is_none() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv search [options] <regex> [<input>]\n    xsv search --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
    let mut re_s = regex_str.unwrap();
    if ignore_case { if !re_s.starts_with("(?i)") { re_s = format!("(?i){}", re_s); } }
    let re = match regex::Regex::new(&re_s) { Ok(r)=>r, Err(e)=>{ eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1); } };
    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter: delim, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    if let Some(ref p) = input { if p!="-" { let ip=format!("{}.idx", p); if Path::new(&ip).exists() && check_stale(p) { eprintln!("The CSV file was modified after the index file. Please re-create the index."); std::process::exit(1); } } }
    let data = read_input_bytes(input);
    let parsed = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) { Ok(p)=>p, Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } };
    if parsed.records.is_empty() { return; }
    let headers = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed.records[0].clone() };
    let data_recs = if no_headers { parsed.records.clone() } else { parsed.records[1..].to_vec() };
    let num_cols = if no_headers { parsed.records[0].len() } else { headers.len() };
    let mut search_idxs = Vec::new();
    if let Some(s_str)=sel {
        let (inv, inner) = if s_str.starts_with('!') { (true, s_str[1..].to_string()) } else { (false, s_str.clone()) };
        let mut sel_idxs = Vec::new();
        if !inner.is_empty() {
            let toks = split_selectors(&inner);
            for tok in toks {
                if tok.is_empty() { continue; }
                if let Some((l, r_opt)) = split_range(&tok) {
                    if l.is_empty() { eprintln!("Expected end of field but got '-' instead."); std::process::exit(1); }
                    let lr = resolve_item(&l, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    let li = lr[0];
                    if let Some(r) = r_opt {
                        if r.is_empty() {
                            for idx in li..num_cols { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                        } else {
                            let rr = resolve_item(&r, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                            let ri = rr[0];
                            if li <= ri { for idx in li..=ri { sel_idxs.push(idx); } } else { for idx in (ri..=li).rev() { sel_idxs.push(idx); } }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    let mut ids = resolve_item(&tok, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    sel_idxs.append(&mut ids);
                }
            }
        }
        if inv {
            let set: HashSet<usize> = sel_idxs.into_iter().collect();
            search_idxs = (0..num_cols).filter(|i| !set.contains(i)).collect();
        } else { search_idxs = sel_idxs; }
    } else {
        search_idxs = (0..num_cols).collect();
    }
    let mut w = open_output(out);
    if !no_headers {
        write_csv_record(&mut w, &headers, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
    for rec in data_recs {
        let mut matched = false;
        for &c in &search_idxs {
            if c < rec.len() && re.is_match(&rec[c]) { matched=true; break; }
        }
        if (matched && !invert) || (!matched && invert) {
            write_csv_record(&mut w, &rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
        }
    }
}

        } else {
            if input.is_some() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv slice [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            input=Some(a.clone());
        }
        i+=1;
    }
    let (s,e) = if let Some(idx) = idx_opt { (idx, idx+1) } else {
        let s = start.unwrap_or(0);
        let e = if let Some(l) = len_opt { s+l } else if let Some(ev) = end { ev } else { u64::MAX };
        (s,e)
    };
    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter: delim, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };

    let headers = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed.records[0].clone() };

    if idx_opt.is_some() && s >= data_len {
        eprintln!("invalid record index {} (there are {} records)", s, data_len);
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let mut w = open_output(out);
    if !no_headers {
        write_csv_record(&mut w, &headers, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
    let actual_end = if e==u64::MAX { data_len } else { std::cmp::min(e, data_len) };
    let actual_start = std::cmp::min(s, data_len);
    for idx in actual_start..actual_end {
        write_csv_record(&mut w, &data_recs[idx as usize], b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
}

    if let Some(s_str)=sel {
        let (inv, inner) = if s_str.starts_with('!') { (true, s_str[1..].to_string()) } else { (false, s_str.clone()) };
        let mut sel_idxs = Vec::new();
        if !inner.is_empty() {
            let toks = split_selectors(&inner);
            for tok in toks {
                if tok.is_empty() { continue; }
                if let Some((l, r_opt)) = split_range(&tok) {
                    if l.is_empty() { eprintln!("Expected end of field but got '-' instead."); std::process::exit(1); }
                    let lr = resolve_item(&l, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    let li = lr[0];
                    if let Some(r) = r_opt {
                        if r.is_empty() {
                            for idx in li..num_cols { sel_idxs.push(idx); }
                        } else {
                            let rr = resolve_item(&r, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                            let ri = rr[0];
                            if li <= ri { for idx in li..=ri { sel_idxs.push(idx); } } else { for idx in (ri..=li).rev() { sel_idxs.push(idx); } }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    let mut ids = resolve_item(&tok, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    sel_idxs.append(&mut ids);
                }
            }
        }
        if inv {
            let set: HashSet<usize> = sel_idxs.into_iter().collect();
            sort_idxs = (0..num_cols).filter(|i| !set.contains(i)).collect();
        } else { sort_idxs = sel_idxs; }
    } else {
        sort_idxs = (0..num_cols).collect();
    }
    data_recs.sort_by(|a,b| {
        for &col in &sort_idxs {
            let av = if col < a.len() { &a[col] } else { "" };
            let bv = if col < b.len() { &b[col] } else { "" };
            let ord = if numeric {
                let an = av.parse::<f64>();
                let bn = bv.parse::<f64>();
                if let (Ok(an), Ok(bn)) = (an,bn) { an.partial_cmp(&bn).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal) } else { av.cmp(bv) }
            } else { av.cmp(bv) };
            if ord != std::cmp::Ordering::Equal {
                return if rev { ord.reverse() } else { ord };
            }
        }
        std::cmp::Ordering::Equal
    });
    let mut w = open_output(out);
    if !no_headers {
        write_csv_record(&mut w, &headers, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
    for rec in data_recs { write_csv_record(&mut w, &rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap(); }
}

fn cmd_split(args: &[String]) {
    let mut delim = b',';
    let mut no_headers = false;
    let mut size: usize = 500;
    let mut filename_template = "{}.csv".to_string();
    let mut outdir: Option<String> = None;
    let mut input: Option<String> = None;
    let mut i=0;
    while i<args.len() {
        let a=&args[i];
        if a=="-h"||a=="--help" { print!("{}", get_help("split").unwrap()); return; }
        else if a=="-n"||a=="--no-headers" { no_headers=true; }
        else if a=="-s"||a=="--size" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv split [options] <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv split --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match args[i].parse::<usize>() { Ok(v)=>size=v, Err(_) => { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--size'.", args[i]); std::process::exit(1); } }
        } else if a.starts_with("--size=") {
            let val=&a["--size=".len()..];
            match val.parse::<usize>() { Ok(v)=>size=v, Err(_) => { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--size'.", val); std::process::exit(1); } }
        } else if a.starts_with("-s") && a.len()>2 {
            let val=&a[2..];
            match val.parse::<usize>() { Ok(v)=>size=v, Err(_) => { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--size'.", val); std::process::exit(1); } }
        } else if a=="-j"||a=="--jobs" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv split [options] <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv split --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            let _ = args[i].parse::<usize>().unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--jobs'.", args[i]); std::process::exit(1); });
        } else if a.starts_with("--jobs=") {
            let val=&a["--jobs=".len()..];
            let _ = val.parse::<usize>().unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--jobs'.", val); std::process::exit(1); });
        } else if a.starts_with("-j") && a.len()>2 {
            let val=&a[2..];
            let _ = val.parse::<usize>().unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--jobs'.", val); std::process::exit(1); });
        } else if a=="--filename" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv split [options] <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv split --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            filename_template=args[i].clone();
        } else if a.starts_with("--filename=") {
            filename_template=a["--filename=".len()..].to_string();
        } else if a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv split [options] <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv split --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
            match parse_delim(&a[2..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
            match parse_delim(&a["--delimiter=".len()..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-") {
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    xsv split [options] <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv split --help", a);
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else {
            if outdir.is_none() { outdir=Some(a.clone()); }
            else if input.is_none() { input=Some(a.clone()); }
            else { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv split [options] <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv split --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
        }
        i+=1;
    }
    if outdir.is_none() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv split [options] <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv split --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
    let outdir_str = outdir.unwrap();
    if !filename_template.contains("{}") { eprintln!("The --filename argument must contain one '{{}}'."); std::process::exit(1); }
    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter: delim, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    if let Some(ref p) = input { if p!="-" { let ip=format!("{}.idx", p); if Path::new(&ip).exists() && check_stale(p) { eprintln!("The CSV file was modified after the index file. Please re-create the index."); std::process::exit(1); } } }
    let data = read_input_bytes(input);
    let parsed = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) { Ok(p)=>p, Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } };
    if parsed.records.is_empty() { return; }
    let headers = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed.records[0].clone() };
    let data_recs = if no_headers { parsed.records.clone() } else { parsed.records[1..].to_vec() };
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&outdir_str).unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", outdir_str); std::process::exit(1); });
    let mut chunk_idx=0;
    let mut cur_chunk: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::new();
    for rec in data_recs {
        cur_chunk.push(rec);
        if cur_chunk.len()>=size {
            let filename = filename_template.replace("{}", &chunk_idx.to_string());
            let full = Path::new(&outdir_str).join(filename);
            let mut f = File::create(&full).unwrap();
            let mut w = BufWriter::new(f);
            if !no_headers { write_csv_record(&mut w, &headers, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap(); }
            for r in &cur_chunk { write_csv_record(&mut w, r, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap(); }
            chunk_idx+=1;
            cur_chunk.clear();
        }
    }
    if !cur_chunk.is_empty() {
        let filename = filename_template.replace("{}", &chunk_idx.to_string());
        let full = Path::new(&outdir_str).join(filename);
        let mut f = File::create(&full).unwrap();
        let mut w = BufWriter::new(f);
        if !no_headers { write_csv_record(&mut w, &headers, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap(); }
        for r in &cur_chunk { write_csv_record(&mut w, r, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap(); }
    }
}

fn cmd_stats(args: &[String]) {
    let mut delim = b',';
    let mut out: Option<String> = None;
    let mut no_headers = false;
    let mut sel: Option<String> = None;
    let mut everything = false;
    let mut mode = false;
    let mut card = false;
    let mut med = false;
    let mut nulls = false;
    let mut input: Option<String> = None;
    let mut i=0;
    while i<args.len() {
        let a=&args[i];
        if a=="-h"||a=="--help" { print!("{}", get_help("stats").unwrap()); return; }
        else if a=="-n"||a=="--no-headers" { no_headers=true; }
        else if a=="--everything" { everything=true; }
        else if a=="--mode" { mode=true; }
        else if a=="--cardinality" { card=true; }
        else if a=="--median" { med=true; }
        else if a=="--nulls" { nulls=true; }
        else if a=="-s"||a=="--select" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv stats [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            sel=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if a.starts_with("--select=") { sel=Some(a["--select=".len()..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-s") && a.len()>2 { sel=Some(a[2..].to_string()); }
        else if a=="-j"||a=="--jobs" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv stats [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            let _ = args[i].parse::<usize>().unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--jobs'.", args[i]); std::process::exit(1); });
        } else if a.starts_with("--jobs=") {
            let val=&a["--jobs=".len()..];
            let _ = val.parse::<usize>().unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--jobs'.", val); std::process::exit(1); });
        } else if a.starts_with("-j") && a.len()>2 {
            let val=&a[2..];
            let _ = val.parse::<usize>().unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--jobs'.", val); std::process::exit(1); });
        } else if a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv stats [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
            match parse_delim(&a[2..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
            match parse_delim(&a["--delimiter=".len()..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a=="-o"||a=="--output" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv stats [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            out=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if a.starts_with("--output=") { out=Some(a["--output=".len()..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-o") && a.len()>2 { out=Some(a[2..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-") {
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    xsv stats [options] [<input>]", a);
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else {
            if input.is_some() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv stats [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            input=Some(a.clone());
        }
        i+=1;
    }
    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter: delim, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    if let Some(ref p) = input { if p!="-" { let ip=format!("{}.idx", p); if Path::new(&ip).exists() && check_stale(p) { eprintln!("The CSV file was modified after the index file. Please re-create the index."); std::process::exit(1); } } }
    let data = read_input_bytes(input);
    let parsed = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) { Ok(p)=>p, Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } };
    if parsed.records.is_empty() {
        let mut w = open_output(out);
        let hdr = if everything { vec!["field","type","sum","min","max","min_length","max_length","mean","stddev","median","mode","cardinality"] } else {
            let mut h = vec!["field","type","sum","min","max","min_length","max_length","mean","stddev"];
            if med { h.push("median"); }
            if mode { h.push("mode"); }
            if card { h.push("cardinality"); }
            h
        };
        write_csv_record(&mut w, &hdr.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>(), b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
        return;
    }
    let headers = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed.records[0].clone() };
    let data_recs = if no_headers { parsed.records.clone() } else { parsed.records[1..].to_vec() };
    let num_cols = if no_headers { parsed.records[0].len() } else { headers.len() };
    let mut col_idxs = Vec::new();
    if let Some(s_str)=sel {
        let (inv, inner) = if s_str.starts_with('!') { (true, s_str[1..].to_string()) } else { (false, s_str.clone()) };
        let mut sel_idxs = Vec::new();
        if !inner.is_empty() {
            let toks = split_selectors(&inner);
            for tok in toks {
                if tok.is_empty() { continue; }
                if let Some((l, r_opt)) = split_range(&tok) {
                    if l.is_empty() { eprintln!("Expected end of field but got '-' instead."); std::process::exit(1); }
                    let lr = resolve_item(&l, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    let li = lr[0];
                    if let Some(r) = r_opt {
                        if r.is_empty() { for idx in li..num_cols { sel_idxs.push(idx); } }
                        else {
                            let rr = resolve_item(&r, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                            let ri = rr[0];
                            if li <= ri { for idx in li..=ri { sel_idxs.push(idx); } } else { for idx in (ri..=li).rev() { sel_idxs.push(idx); } }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    let mut ids = resolve_item(&tok, &headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    sel_idxs.append(&mut ids);
                }
            }
        }
        if inv {
            let set: HashSet<usize> = sel_idxs.into_iter().collect();
            col_idxs = (0..num_cols).filter(|i| !set.contains(i)).collect();
        } else { col_idxs = sel_idxs; }
    } else {
        col_idxs = (0..num_cols).collect();
    }

    // compute stats
    struct Col {
        values: Vec<String>,
        sum: f64,
        min: Option<String>,
        max: Option<String>,
        min_len: Option<usize>,
        max_len: usize,
        count: usize,
        total: usize,
        is_int: bool,
        is_float: bool,
    }
    let mut cols: Vec<Col> = (0..num_cols).map(|_| Col { values: Vec::new(), sum:0.0, min:None, max:None, min_len:None, max_len:0, count:0, total:0, is_int:true, is_float:true }).collect();

    for rec in &data_recs {
        for &cidx in &col_idxs {
            if cidx>=rec.len() { continue; }
            let val = rec[cidx].clone();
            let is_null = val.is_empty();
            let col = &mut cols[cidx];
            col.total+=1;
            if is_null {
                // lengths 0
                col.max_len = col.max_len.max(0);
                if let Some(ml)=col.min_len { col.min_len=Some(ml.min(0)); } else { col.min_len=Some(0); }
                // if nulls flag set, include null in mean/stddev? Then count as 0? Let's not include in sum but total includes
                continue;
            }
            col.count+=1;
            col.values.push(val.clone());
            let char_len = val.chars().count();
            col.max_len = col.max_len.max(char_len);
            if let Some(ml)=col.min_len { col.min_len=Some(ml.min(char_len)); } else { col.min_len=Some(char_len); }
            if col.is_int && val.parse::<i64>().is_err() { col.is_int=false; }
            if col.is_float && val.parse::<f64>().is_err() { col.is_float=false; }
            if let Ok(f)=val.parse::<f64>() { col.sum+=f; }
            if let Some(ref cur_min)=col.min { if val < *cur_min { col.min=Some(val.clone()); } } else { col.min=Some(val.clone()); }
            if let Some(ref cur_max)=col.max { if val > *cur_max { col.max=Some(val.clone()); } } else { col.max=Some(val.clone()); }
        }
    }

    // handle nulls inclusion for mean/stddev: if nulls flag, total includes nulls, but sum only non-null
    // For min_len etc, we already handled null as 0

    let mut header_fields = vec!["field".to_string(),"type".to_string(),"sum".to_string(),"min".to_string(),"max".to_string(),"min_length".to_string(),"max_length".to_string(),"mean".to_string(),"stddev".to_string()];
    if everything {
        header_fields = vec!["field".to_string(),"type".to_string(),"sum".to_string(),"min".to_string(),"max".to_string(),"min_length".to_string(),"max_length".to_string(),"mean".to_string(),"stddev".to_string(),"median".to_string(),"mode".to_string(),"cardinality".to_string()];
    } else {
        if med { header_fields.push("median".to_string()); }
        if mode { header_fields.push("mode".to_string()); }
        if card { header_fields.push("cardinality".to_string()); }
    }

    let mut w = open_output(out);
    write_csv_record(&mut w, &header_fields, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();

    for &cidx in &col_idxs {
        let col = &cols[cidx];
        let field_name = if no_headers { cidx.to_string() } else { if cidx < headers.len() { headers[cidx].clone() } else { cidx.to_string() } };
        let type_str = if col.is_int && col.count>0 { "Integer" } else if col.is_float && col.count>0 { "Float" } else { "Unicode" };
        let sum_str = if col.count==0 { "".to_string() } else {
            if type_str=="Integer" { format!("{}", col.sum as i64) } else { if col.sum.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", col.sum as i64) } else { format!("{}", col.sum) } }
        };
        let min_str = col.min.clone().unwrap_or_default();
        let max_str = col.max.clone().unwrap_or_default();
        let min_len_str = col.min_len.map(|v| v.to_string()).unwrap_or_default();
        let max_len_str = col.max_len.to_string();
        let mean_str = if col.count==0 && !nulls { "".to_string() } else {
            let denom = if nulls { col.total } else { col.count };
            if denom==0 { "".to_string() } else {
                let mean = col.sum / denom as f64;
                if mean.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", mean as i64) } else { format!("{}", mean) }
            }
        };
        let stddev_str = if col.count==0 && !nulls { "".to_string() } else {
            let denom = if nulls { col.total } else { col.count };
            if denom==0 { "".to_string() } else {
                let mean = col.sum / denom as f64;
                let mut var = 0.0;
                let mut n=0;
                for v in &col.values {
                    if let Ok(f)=v.parse::<f64>() { var+=(f-mean).powi(2); n+=1; }
                }
                let total_n = if nulls { denom } else { n };
                if total_n==0 { "".to_string() } else {
                    let stddev = (var / total_n as f64).sqrt();
                    format!("{}", stddev)
                }
            }
        };

        let mut out_rec = vec![field_name, type_str.to_string(), sum_str, min_str, max_str, min_len_str, max_len_str, mean_str, stddev_str];

        if everything {
            // median
            let median_str = {
                let mut nums: Vec<f64> = col.values.iter().filter_map(|v| v.parse::<f64>().ok()).collect();
                if nums.is_empty() { "".to_string() } else {
                    nums.sort_by(|a,b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
                    let mid = nums.len()/2;
                    if nums.len()%2==0 {
                        let m = (nums[mid-1]+nums[mid])/2.0;
                        if m.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", m as i64) } else { format!("{}", m) }
                    } else {
                        let m = nums[mid];
                        if m.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", m as i64) } else { format!("{}", m) }
                    }
                }
            };
            let mode_str = {
                let mut freq: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
                for v in &col.values { *freq.entry(v.clone()).or_insert(0)+=1; }
                if freq.is_empty() { "".to_string() } else {
                    let max_c = freq.values().cloned().max().unwrap_or(0);
                    if max_c<=1 { "N/A".to_string() } else {
                        let mut mv = "";
                        for v in &col.values { if freq.get(v).unwrap_or(&0)==&max_c { mv=v; break; } }
                        mv.to_string()
                    }
                }
            };
            let card_str = {
                let mut set = HashSet::new();
                for v in &col.values { set.insert(v); }
                set.len().to_string()
            };
            out_rec.push(median_str);
            out_rec.push(mode_str);
            out_rec.push(card_str);
        } else {
            if med {
                let mut nums: Vec<f64> = col.values.iter().filter_map(|v| v.parse::<f64>().ok()).collect();
                let median_str = if nums.is_empty() { "".to_string() } else {
                    nums.sort_by(|a,b| a.partial_cmp(b).unwrap());
                    let mid = nums.len()/2;
                    if nums.len()%2==0 {
                        let m = (nums[mid-1]+nums[mid])/2.0;
                        if m.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", m as i64) } else { format!("{}", m) }
                    } else {
                        let m = nums[mid];
                        if m.fract()==0.0 { format!("{}", m as i64) } else { format!("{}", m) }
                    }
                };
                out_rec.push(median_str);
            }
            if mode {
                let mut freq: HashMap<String, usize> = HashMap::new();
                for v in &col.values { *freq.entry(v.clone()).or_insert(0)+=1; }
                let mode_str = if freq.is_empty() { "".to_string() } else {
                    let max_c = freq.values().cloned().max().unwrap_or(0);
                    if max_c<=1 { "N/A".to_string() } else {
                        let mut mv = "";
                        for v in &col.values { if freq.get(v).unwrap_or(&0)==&max_c { mv=v; break; } }
                        mv.to_string()
                    }
                };
                out_rec.push(mode_str);
            }
            if card {
                let mut set = HashSet::new();
                for v in &col.values { set.insert(v); }
                out_rec.push(set.len().to_string());
            }
        }

        write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
}

        } else if a.starts_with("--pad=") {

            match val.parse::<usize>() { Ok(v)=>pad=v, Err(_) => { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--pad'.", val); std::process::exit(1); } }
        } else if a.starts_with("-p") && a.len()>2 {
            let val=&a[2..];
            match val.parse::<usize>() { Ok(v)=>pad=v, Err(_) => { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--pad'.", val); std::process::exit(1); } }
        } else if a=="-c"||a=="--condense" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv table [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match args[i].parse::<usize>() { Ok(v)=>condense=Some(v), Err(_) => { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--condense'.", args[i]); std::process::exit(1); } }
        } else if a.starts_with("--condense=") {
            let val=&a["--condense=".len()..];

        } else if a.starts_with("-c") && a.len()>2 {
            let val=&a[2..];
            match val.parse::<usize>() { Ok(v)=>condense=Some(v), Err(_) => { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--condense'.", val); std::process::exit(1); } }
        } else if a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv table [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
            match parse_delim(&a[2..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
            match parse_delim(&a["--delimiter=".len()..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a=="-o"||a=="--output" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv table [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            out=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if a.starts_with("--output=") { out=Some(a["--output=".len()..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-o") && a.len()>2 { out=Some(a[2..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-") {
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    xsv table [options] [<input>]", a);
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else {
            if input.is_some() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv table [options] [<input>]"); std::process::exit(1); }
            input=Some(a.clone());
        }
        i+=1;
    }
    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter: delim, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    let data = read_input_bytes(input);
    let parsed = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) { Ok(p)=>p, Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } };
    if parsed.records.is_empty() { return; }
    let mut recs = parsed.records.clone();
    if let Some(c) = condense {
        for rec in recs.iter_mut() {
            for field in rec.iter_mut() {
                if field.chars().count() > c {
                    let mut new: String = field.chars().take(c).collect();
                    new.push_str("...");
                    *field = new;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let num_cols = recs.iter().map(|r| r.len()).max().unwrap_or(0);
    let mut max_widths = vec![width; num_cols];
    for rec in &recs {
        for (i,f) in rec.iter().enumerate() {
            let w = f.chars().count();
            if w > max_widths[i] { max_widths[i]=w; }
        }
    }
    let mut w = open_output(out);
    for rec in recs {
        for (i,f) in rec.iter().enumerate() {
            if i>0 { for _ in 0..pad { write!(w, " ").unwrap(); } }
            let fw = f.chars().count();
            write!(w, "{}", f).unwrap();
            if i+1 < rec.len() {
                for _ in 0..(max_widths[i]-fw) { write!(w, " ").unwrap(); }
            }
        }
        writeln!(w).unwrap();
    }
}

fn cmd_join(args: &[String]) {
    let mut delim = b',';
    let mut out: Option<String> = None;
    let mut no_headers = false;
    let mut no_case = false;
    let mut left = false;
    let mut right = false;
    let mut full = false;
    let mut cross = false;
    let mut nulls = false;
    let mut i=0;
    let mut cols1: Option<String> = None;
    let mut in1: Option<String> = None;
    let mut cols2: Option<String> = None;
    let mut in2: Option<String> = None;
    while i<args.len() {
        let a=&args[i];
        if a=="-h"||a=="--help" { print!("{}", get_help("join").unwrap()); return; }
        else if a=="--no-case" { no_case=true; }
        else if a=="--left" { left=true; }
        else if a=="--right" { right=true; }
        else if a=="--full" { full=true; }
        else if a=="--cross" { cross=true; }
        else if a=="--nulls" { nulls=true; }
        else if a=="-n"||a=="--no-headers" { no_headers=true; }
        else if a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv join [options] <columns1> <input1> <columns2> <input2>\n    xsv join --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
            match parse_delim(&a[2..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
            match parse_delim(&a["--delimiter=".len()..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a=="-o"||a=="--output" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv join [options] <columns1> <input1> <columns2> <input2>\n    xsv join --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            out=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if a.starts_with("--output=") { out=Some(a["--output=".len()..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-o") && a.len()>2 { out=Some(a[2..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-") {
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    xsv join [options] <columns1> <input1> <columns2> <input2>\n    xsv join --help", a);
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else {
            if cols1.is_none() { cols1=Some(a.clone()); }
            else if in1.is_none() { in1=Some(a.clone()); }
            else if cols2.is_none() { cols2=Some(a.clone()); }
            else if in2.is_none() { in2=Some(a.clone()); }
            else { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv join [options] <columns1> <input1> <columns2> <input2>\n    xsv join --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
        }
        i+=1;
    }
    if cols1.is_none() || in1.is_none() || cols2.is_none() || in2.is_none() {
        eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv join [options] <columns1> <input1> <columns2> <input2>\n    xsv join --help");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let ops = [left,right,full,cross].iter().filter(|&&x| x).count();
    if ops>1 { eprintln!("Please pick exactly one join operation."); std::process::exit(1); }

    let c1 = cols1.unwrap();
    let i1 = in1.unwrap();
    let c2 = cols2.unwrap();
    let i2 = in2.unwrap();

    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter: delim, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    for p in [&i1,&i2] { let ip=format!("{}.idx", p); if Path::new(&ip).exists() && check_stale(p) { eprintln!("The CSV file was modified after the index file. Please re-create the index."); std::process::exit(1); } }

    let data1 = match std::fs::read(&i1) { Ok(b)=>b, Err(_)=>{ eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", i1); std::process::exit(1); } };
    let data2 = match std::fs::read(&i2) { Ok(b)=>b, Err(_)=>{ eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", i2); std::process::exit(1); } };

    let parsed1 = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data1, &cfg) { Ok(p)=>p, Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } };
    let parsed2 = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data2, &cfg) { Ok(p)=>p, Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } };

    if parsed1.records.is_empty() || parsed2.records.is_empty() { return; }

    let headers1 = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed1.records[0].clone() };
    let headers2 = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed2.records[0].clone() };
    let recs1 = if no_headers { parsed1.records.clone() } else { parsed1.records[1..].to_vec() };
    let recs2 = if no_headers { parsed2.records.clone() } else { parsed2.records[1..].to_vec() };

    let num_cols1 = if no_headers { parsed1.records[0].len() } else { headers1.len() };
    let num_cols2 = if no_headers { parsed2.records[0].len() } else { headers2.len() };

    let mut w = open_output(out);
    if !no_headers {
        let mut hdr = Vec::new();
        hdr.extend(headers1.clone());
        hdr.extend(headers2.clone());
        write_csv_record(&mut w, &hdr, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }

    if cross {
        for r1 in &recs1 {
            for r2 in &recs2 {
                let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
                out_rec.extend(r1.clone());
                out_rec.extend(r2.clone());
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    let join_idx1 = parse_join_columns(&c1, &headers1, num_cols1, no_headers);
    let join_idx2 = parse_join_columns(&c2, &headers2, num_cols2, no_headers);
    if join_idx1.len()!=join_idx2.len() { eprintln!("Both columns1 and columns2 must specify exactly the same number of columns."); std::process::exit(1); }

    // Build map for second file
    let mut map: HashMap<String, Vec<(usize, Vec<String>)>> = HashMap::new();
    for (idx2, rec2) in recs2.iter().enumerate() {
        let mut skip=false;
        let mut key_parts=Vec::new();
        for &c in &join_idx2 {
            if c>=rec2.len() { continue; }
            let v = rec2[c].trim().to_string();
            if !nulls && v.is_empty() { skip=true; break; }
            let kv = if no_case { v.to_lowercase() } else { v };
            key_parts.push(kv);
        }
        if skip { continue; }
        let key = key_parts.join("\0");
        map.entry(key).or_insert(Vec::new()).push((idx2, rec2.clone()));
    }

    let mut matched2 = vec![false; recs2.len()];

    for rec1 in &recs1 {
        let mut skip=false;
        let mut key_parts=Vec::new();
        for &c in &join_idx1 {
            if c>=rec1.len() { continue; }
            let v = rec1[c].trim().to_string();
            if !nulls && v.is_empty() { skip=true; break; }
            let kv = if no_case { v.to_lowercase() } else { v };
            key_parts.push(kv);
        }
        if skip {
            if left || full {
                let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
                out_rec.extend(rec1.clone());
                for _ in 0..num_cols2 { out_rec.push(String::new()); }
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
            continue;
        }
        let key = key_parts.join("\0");
        if let Some(list) = map.get(&key) {
            for (idx2, rec2) in list {
                matched2[*idx2]=true;
                let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
                out_rec.extend(rec1.clone());
                out_rec.extend(rec2.clone());
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
        } else {
            if left || full {
                let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
                out_rec.extend(rec1.clone());
                for _ in 0..num_cols2 { out_rec.push(String::new()); }
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
        }
    }

    if right || full {
        for (idx2, rec2) in recs2.iter().enumerate() {
            if !matched2[idx2] {
                let mut skip=false;
                for &c in &join_idx2 {
                    if c>=rec2.len() { continue; }
                    let v = rec2[c].trim().to_string();
                    if !nulls && v.is_empty() { skip=true; break; }
                }
                if skip { continue; }
                let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
                for _ in 0..num_cols1 { out_rec.push(String::new()); }
                out_rec.extend(rec2.clone());
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
        }
    }
}

            match args[i].parse::<usize>() { Ok(v)=>prefix=Some(v), Err(_) => { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--prefix-length'.", args[i]); std::process::exit(1); } }
        } else if a.starts_with("--prefix-length=") {
            let val=&a["--prefix-length=".len()..];
            match val.parse::<usize>() { Ok(v)=>prefix=Some(v), Err(_) => { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--prefix-length'.", val); std::process::exit(1); } }
        } else if a.starts_with("-p") && a.len()>2 {
            let val=&a[2..];
            match val.parse::<usize>() { Ok(v)=>prefix=Some(v), Err(_) => { eprintln!("Could not deserialize '{}' to u64 for '--prefix-length'.", val); std::process::exit(1); } }
        } else if a=="--filename" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv partition [options] <column> <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv partition --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            filename_template=args[i].clone();
        } else if a.starts_with("--filename=") {
            filename_template=a["--filename=".len()..].to_string();
        } else if a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv partition [options] <column> <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv partition --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
            match parse_delim(&a[2..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
            match parse_delim(&a["--delimiter=".len()..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-") {
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    xsv partition [options] <column> <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv partition --help", a);
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else {
            if column.is_none() { column=Some(a.clone()); }
            else if outdir.is_none() { outdir=Some(a.clone()); }
            else if input.is_none() { input=Some(a.clone()); }
            else { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv partition [options] <column> <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv partition --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
        }
        i+=1;
    }
    if column.is_none() || outdir.is_none() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv partition [options] <column> <outdir> [<input>]\n    xsv partition --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
    if !filename_template.contains("{}") { eprintln!("The --filename argument must contain one '{{}}'."); std::process::exit(1); }
    let col_str = column.unwrap();
    let outdir_str = outdir.unwrap();
    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter: delim, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    let data = read_input_bytes(input);
    let parsed = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data, &cfg) { Ok(p)=>p, Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } };
    if parsed.records.is_empty() { return; }
    let headers = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed.records[0].clone() };
    let data_recs = if no_headers { parsed.records.clone() } else { parsed.records[1..].to_vec() };
    let num_cols = if no_headers { parsed.records[0].len() } else { headers.len() };
    let col_idx = parse_join_columns(&col_str, &headers, num_cols, no_headers)[0];
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&outdir_str).unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", outdir_str); std::process::exit(1); });
    let mut writers: HashMap<String, BufWriter<File>> = HashMap::new();
    for rec in data_recs {
        if col_idx>=rec.len() { continue; }
        let mut part_val = rec[col_idx].clone();
        if let Some(pl)=prefix {
            if part_val.len()>pl { part_val=part_val[..pl].to_string(); }
        }
        let key = sanitize_filename(&part_val);
        let filename = filename_template.replace("{}", &key);
        let full = Path::new(&outdir_str).join(filename);
        if !writers.contains_key(&key) {
            let f = File::create(&full).unwrap();
            let mut w = BufWriter::new(f);
            if !no_headers {
                let mut hdr = Vec::new();
                for (i,h) in headers.iter().enumerate() { if drop && i==col_idx { continue; } hdr.push(h.clone()); }
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &hdr, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
            writers.insert(key.clone(), w);
        }
        let w = writers.get_mut(&key).unwrap();
        let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
        for (i,f) in rec.iter().enumerate() { if drop && i==col_idx { continue; } out_rec.push(f.clone()); }
        write_csv_record(w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
}

        }

    let data_recs = if no_headers { parsed.records.clone() } else { parsed.records[1..].to_vec() };

    use rand::rngs::StdRng;
    let seed_val = seed.unwrap_or_else(|| { use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH}; SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap().as_secs() });

                let data_total = if no_headers { count } else { if count==0 {0} else { count-1 } } as usize;

            for (i, rec) in data_recs.iter().enumerate() {

// CSV config

#[derive(Clone)]
struct CsvConfig {
    delimiter: u8,
    quote: u8,
    escape: Option<u8>,
    quoting: bool,
}

fn parse_delim(s: &str) -> Result<u8, String> {
    if s.chars().count() != 1 {
        return Err(format!("Could not convert '{}' to a single ASCII character.", s));
    }
    let b = s.as_bytes()[0];
    if b > 127 {
        return Err(format!("Could not convert '{}' to a single ASCII character.", s));
    }
    Ok(b)
}

fn read_input_bytes(input: Option<String>) -> Vec<u8> {
    if let Some(p) = input {
        if p == "-" {
            let mut buf = Vec::new();
            io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut buf).unwrap();
            buf
        } else {
            match std::fs::read(&p) {
                Ok(b) => b,
                Err(_) => { eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", p); std::process::exit(1); }
            }
        }
    } else {
        let mut buf = Vec::new();
        io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut buf).unwrap();
        buf
    }
}

fn open_output(path: Option<String>) -> Box<dyn Write> {
    if let Some(p) = path {
        match File::create(&p) {
            Ok(f) => Box::new(BufWriter::new(f)),
            Err(_) => { eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", p); std::process::exit(1); }
        }
    } else {
        Box::new(BufWriter::new(io::stdout()))
    }
}

#[derive(Debug)]
struct ParsedCsv {
    records: Vec<Vec<String>>,
    offsets: Vec<u64>,
}

fn parse_csv_with_blank_handling(data: &[u8], cfg: &CsvConfig) -> Result<ParsedCsv, String> {
    let mut records: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::new();
    let mut offsets: Vec<u64> = Vec::new();
    let mut idx = 0usize;
    let len = data.len();
    let mut pending_blank_start: Option<usize> = None;
    let mut first_len: Option<usize> = None;
    let mut non_blank_line_no: usize = 0; // counts non-blank records for line numbers

    while idx < len {
        // blank line detection: 0 bytes before newline
        if data[idx] == b'\n' {
            if pending_blank_start.is_none() { pending_blank_start = Some(idx); }
            idx+=1;
            continue;
        }
        if data[idx]==b'\r' {
            if idx+1 < len && data[idx+1]==b'\n' {
                // "\r\n" blank line?
                if pending_blank_start.is_none() { pending_blank_start = Some(idx); }
                idx+=2;
                continue;
            } else {
                if pending_blank_start.is_none() { pending_blank_start = Some(idx); }
                idx+=1;
                continue;
            }
        }

        // not blank at idx, parse one CSV record starting at idx
        let rec_offset = pending_blank_start.unwrap_or(idx) as u64;
        let mut field_buf: Vec<u8> = Vec::new();
        let mut rec_fields: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
        let mut in_quote = false;
        let mut at_field_start = true;
        let mut p = idx;

        while p < len {
            let c = data[p];
            if in_quote {
                if let Some(esc) = cfg.escape {
                    if c==esc {
                        if p+1 < len {
                            field_buf.push(data[p+1]);
                            p+=2;
                            at_field_start=false;
                            continue;
                        } else {
                            field_buf.push(c);
                            p+=1;
                            at_field_start=false;
                            continue;
                        }
                    } else if c==cfg.quote {
                        if cfg.escape.is_none() {
                            if p+1 < len && data[p+1]==cfg.quote {
                                field_buf.push(cfg.quote);
                                p+=2;
                                at_field_start=false;
                                continue;
                            } else {
                                in_quote=false;
                                p+=1;
                                at_field_start=false;
                                continue;
                            }
                        } else {
                            in_quote=false;
                            p+=1;
                            at_field_start=false;
                            continue;
                        }
                    } else {
                        field_buf.push(c);
                        p+=1;
                        at_field_start=false;
                        continue;
                    }
                } else {
                    if c==cfg.quote {
                        if p+1 < len && data[p+1]==cfg.quote {
                            field_buf.push(cfg.quote);
                            p+=2;
                            at_field_start=false;
                            continue;
                        } else {
                            in_quote=false;
                            p+=1;
                            at_field_start=false;
                            continue;
                        }
                    } else {
                        field_buf.push(c);
                        p+=1;
                        at_field_start=false;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if cfg.quoting && at_field_start && c==cfg.quote {
                    in_quote=true;
                    p+=1;
                    at_field_start=false;
                    continue;
                }
                if c==cfg.delimiter {
                    rec_fields.push(String::from_utf8_lossy(&field_buf).into_owned());
                    field_buf.clear();
                    at_field_start=true;
                    p+=1;
                    continue;
                }
                if c==b'\n' {
                    rec_fields.push(String::from_utf8_lossy(&field_buf).into_owned());
                    field_buf.clear();
                    p+=1;
                    break;
                }
                if c==b'\r' {
                    rec_fields.push(String::from_utf8_lossy(&field_buf).into_owned());
                    field_buf.clear();
                    p+=1;
                    if p < len && data[p]==b'\n' { p+=1; }
                    break;
                }
                field_buf.push(c);
                p+=1;
                at_field_start=false;
            }
        }

        // EOF without newline: push pending field
        if p>=len && (!field_buf.is_empty() || !rec_fields.is_empty() || at_field_start==false) {
            // If we have not yet pushed last field (because no delimiter newline)
            // Check if we already pushed due to loop break? For EOF case, we didn't push last field yet if we exited via p==len without hitting newline
            // In our loop above, when we hit EOF, we break out of inner while without pushing? Actually we only push on delimiter or newline. At EOF, field_buf may contain data.
            // So push it
            if !field_buf.is_empty() || at_field_start==true {
                // If at_field_start true and field_buf empty, we might have trailing delimiter? For simplicity, if rec_fields is not empty and we are at EOF after delimiter, we already have field? Actually trailing delimiter case: "a,b," -> fields: a,b,"" . Our logic: when delimiter encountered, we push field and clear. At end, field_buf empty, but we need to push empty field for trailing delimiter. How to detect trailing delimiter? If last char was delimiter, then at_field_start would be true and rec_fields would have one less than expected. So we should push empty field if last char was delimiter.
                // For now, handle: if p==len and (data[len-1]==cfg.delimiter) then need empty field
                // Simpler: if we have field_buf not empty or at_field_start and rec_fields not empty, push
            }
            // If we still have field_buf, push
            if !field_buf.is_empty() || (idx>0 && data[idx-1]==cfg.delimiter) || rec_fields.is_empty() {
                // Actually for safety, if we have not yet pushed field_buf, push it if we are in non-blank record
                // For record like "a,b" without newline, after loop p==len, field_buf contains "b", rec_fields contains ["a"], so we need to push "b"
                if field_buf.is_empty() && rec_fields.is_empty() {
                    // nothing
                } else {
                    if !field_buf.is_empty() || at_field_start {
                        // If at_field_start true after delimiter, field_buf empty but we need empty field
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // The above logic for EOF is messy; let's re-evaluate: our inner loop breaks on newline, pushing field before break. At EOF, it exits without pushing? In our outer while we have p pointing after record? For EOF, p==len and we have field_buf and rec_fields partially. We need to push final field.

        // Actually we have two cases:
        // - If we broke due to newline, we already pushed field and rec_fields is complete.
        // - If we exited because p==len, we have field_buf containing last field not yet pushed, and rec_fields containing previous fields.

        // Let's handle: if p>=len and (field_buf not empty or rec_fields not empty) and final record not yet pushed via break, push field_buf then rec.

        // To simplify, we will after inner loop, if field_buf not empty or rec_fields not empty and we didn't already have complete record via newline break, push.

        // For our implementation, when we break via newline, we pushed field and broke, so rec_fields is complete and field_buf empty.
        // When we exit via p==len, field_buf may have last field.
        if p>=len {
            if !field_buf.is_empty() || !rec_fields.is_empty() {
                if !field_buf.is_empty() || rec_fields.len()>0 {
                    // If field_buf empty but we are after delimiter? Might need empty field. For simplicity, push field_buf as string (could be empty)
                    if at_field_start && field_buf.is_empty() && !rec_fields.is_empty() {
                        // trailing empty field due to delimiter at end? Actually if file ends with delimiter, field_buf empty and at_field_start true, we should push empty?
                        // Example "a,b," -> after parsing "a" delimiter, field pushed, then "b" delimiter, field pushed, then at field start, field_buf empty, p==len, we should push empty field.
                        rec_fields.push(String::new());
                    } else {
                        if !field_buf.is_empty() || !rec_fields.is_empty() {
                            let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&field_buf).into_owned();
                            // Only push if not already pushed? For EOF, we have not pushed last field yet.
                            // Check if we have field_buf that wasn't pushed: if we have rec_fields already containing some fields and field_buf contains last field, push.
                            // If rec_fields already has complete record via newline break, field_buf would be empty and we would not be here.
                            rec_fields.push(s);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Now rec_fields should be the record
        if rec_fields.is_empty() {
            // Should be blank, but we already filtered blank at start, so this could be empty due to parsing error?
            idx = p;
            continue;
        }

        // Check unequal lengths
        non_blank_line_no+=1;
        if let Some(fl) = first_len {
            if rec_fields.len() != fl {
                let rec_no = non_blank_line_no - 1;
                let line_no = non_blank_line_no;
                let byte_off = rec_offset;
                return Err(format!("record {} (line: {}, byte: {}): found record with {} fields, but the previous record has {} fields", rec_no, line_no, byte_off, rec_fields.len(), fl));
            }
        } else {
            first_len = Some(rec_fields.len());
        }

        records.push(rec_fields);
        offsets.push(rec_offset);
        pending_blank_start = None;
        idx = p;
    }

    Ok(ParsedCsv { records, offsets })
}

fn write_csv_record<W: Write>(writer: &mut W, fields: &[String], out_delim: u8, quote: u8, quote_always: bool, escape: Option<u8>, crlf: bool, ascii: bool) -> std::io::Result<()> {
    let field_sep = if ascii { 0x1Fu8 } else { out_delim };
    let rec_sep = if ascii { 0x1Eu8 } else { b'\n' };
    for (i, f) in fields.iter().enumerate() {
        if i>0 { writer.write_all(&[field_sep])?; }
        let need_quote = if quote_always {
            true
        } else {
            let bytes = f.as_bytes();
            let mut need = false;
            for &b in bytes {
                if b==field_sep || b==rec_sep || b==quote || b==b'\n' || b==b'\r' { need=true; break; }
                if !ascii && b==out_delim { need=true; break; }
            }
            need
        };
        if need_quote {
            writer.write_all(&[quote])?;
            for &b in f.as_bytes() {
                if b==quote {
                    if let Some(esc) = escape {
                        writer.write_all(&[esc])?;
                        writer.write_all(&[quote])?;
                    } else {
                        writer.write_all(&[quote, quote])?;
                    }
                } else {
                    writer.write_all(&[b])?;
                }
            }
            writer.write_all(&[quote])?;
        } else {
            writer.write_all(f.as_bytes())?;
        }
    }
    if crlf && !ascii {
        writer.write_all(b"\r\n")?;
    } else {
        writer.write_all(&[rec_sep])?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

fn check_stale(csv_path: &str) -> bool {
    let idx_path = format!("{}.idx", csv_path);
    let csv_meta = std::fs::metadata(csv_path);
    let idx_meta = std::fs::metadata(&idx_path);
    if let (Ok(c), Ok(i)) = (csv_meta, idx_meta) {
        if let (Ok(c_time), Ok(i_time)) = (c.modified(), i.modified()) {
            if let (Ok(c_dur), Ok(i_dur)) = (c_time.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH), i_time.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)) {
                if c_dur.as_secs() > i_dur.as_secs() { return true; }
            }
        }
    }
    false
}

fn read_index(csv_path: &str) -> Option<(Vec<u64>, u64)> {
    let idx_path = format!("{}.idx", csv_path);
    let data = std::fs::read(&idx_path).ok()?;
    if data.len()%8!=0 { return None; }
    let mut vals = Vec::new();
    for chunk in data.chunks(8) {
        let mut arr=[0u8;8];
        arr.copy_from_slice(chunk);
        vals.push(u64::from_be_bytes(arr));
    }
    if vals.is_empty() { return None; }
    if vals.len()==1 {
        Some((vec![0], 0))
    } else {
        let count = *vals.last().unwrap();
        let offs = vals[..vals.len()-1].to_vec();
        Some((offs, count))
    }
}

// select helpers

fn split_selectors(s: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut tokens = Vec::new();
    let mut cur = String::new();
    let mut in_q = false;
    let bytes = s.as_bytes();
    let mut i=0;
    while i<bytes.len() {
        let c = bytes[i];
        if c==b'"' {
            if in_q {
                if i+1 < bytes.len() && bytes[i+1]==b'"' {
                    cur.push('"');
                    cur.push('"');
                    i+=2;
                    continue;
                } else {
                    in_q=false;
                    cur.push(c as char);
                    i+=1;
                    continue;
                }
            } else {
                in_q=true;
                cur.push(c as char);
                i+=1;
                continue;
            }
        }
        if c==b',' && !in_q {
            tokens.push(cur);
            cur=String::new();
            i+=1;
            continue;
        }
        cur.push(c as char);
        i+=1;
    }
    tokens.push(cur);
    tokens
}

fn split_range(token: &str) -> Option<(String, Option<String>)> {
    let bytes = token.as_bytes();
    let mut in_q = false;
    let mut in_brack = false;
    for (i,&b) in bytes.iter().enumerate() {
        if b==b'"' {
            if in_q {
                if i+1 < bytes.len() && bytes[i+1]==b'"' {
                    continue;
                } else { in_q=false; }
            } else { in_q=true; }
        } else if b==b'[' && !in_q { in_brack=true; }
        else if b==b']' && !in_q { in_brack=false; }
        else if b==b'-' && !in_q && !in_brack {
            let left = token[..i].to_string();
            let right = token[i+1..].to_string();
            return Some((left, Some(right)));
        }
    }
    None
}

fn extract_bracket(item: &str) -> (String, Option<String>) {
    if let Some(st)=item.rfind('[') {
        if item.ends_with(']') {
            let base=item[..st].to_string();
            let idx=item[st+1..item.len()-1].to_string();
            if idx.chars().all(|c|c.is_ascii_digit()) {
                return (base, Some(idx));
            }
        }
    }
    (item.to_string(), None)
}

fn resolve_item(item: &str, headers: &[String], num_cols: usize, no_headers: bool) -> Vec<usize> {
    let (base, idx_opt) = extract_bracket(item);
    let is_numeric = !base.is_empty() && base.chars().all(|c|c.is_ascii_digit());
    if is_numeric && idx_opt.is_none() {
        match base.parse::<usize>() {
            Ok(n)=>{
                if n==0 {
                    eprintln!("Selector index 0 is out of bounds. Index must be >= 1 and <= {}.", num_cols);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
                if n>num_cols {
                    eprintln!("Selector index {} is out of bounds. Index must be >= 1 and <= {}.", n, num_cols);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
                return vec![n-1];
            },
            Err(_)=>{},
        }
    }
    if no_headers {
        eprintln!("Cannot use names ('{}') in selection with --no-headers set.", base);
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let name = if base.starts_with('"') && base.ends_with('"') && base.len()>=2 {
        base[1..base.len()-1].replace("\"\"", "\"")
    } else {
        base.clone()
    };
    let mut matches = Vec::new();
    for (i,h) in headers.iter().enumerate() {
        if h==&name { matches.push(i); }
    }
    if matches.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("Selector name '{}' does not exist as a named header in the given CSV data.", name);
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    if let Some(idx_str)=idx_opt {
        match idx_str.parse::<usize>() {
            Ok(n)=>{
                if n>=matches.len() {
                    eprintln!("Selector index '{}' for name '{}' is out of bounds. Must be >= 0 and <= {}.", n, name, matches.len()-1);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
                return vec![matches[n]];
            },
            Err(_)=>{
                eprintln!("Selector name '{}' does not exist as a named header in the given CSV data.", name);
                std::process::exit(1);
            }
        }
    } else {
        return vec![matches[0]];
    }
}

fn parse_join_columns(sel_str: &str, headers: &[String], num_cols: usize, no_headers: bool) -> Vec<usize> {
    let mut result = Vec::new();
    let tokens = split_selectors(sel_str);
    for token in tokens {
        if token.is_empty() { continue; }
        if let Some((left, right_opt)) = split_range(&token) {
            if left.is_empty() { eprintln!("Expected end of field but got '-' instead."); std::process::exit(1); }
            let left_res = resolve_item(&left, headers, num_cols, no_headers);
            let left_idx = left_res[0];
            if let Some(right) = right_opt {
                if right.is_empty() {
                    for idx in left_idx..num_cols { result.push(idx); }
                } else {
                    let right_res = resolve_item(&right, headers, num_cols, no_headers);
                    let right_idx = right_res[0];
                    if left_idx <= right_idx {
                        for idx in left_idx..=right_idx { result.push(idx); }
                    } else {
                        for idx in (right_idx..=left_idx).rev() { result.push(idx); }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            let mut idxs = resolve_item(&token, headers, num_cols, no_headers);
            result.append(&mut idxs);
        }
    }
    result
}

fn sanitize_filename(s: &str) -> String {
    if s.is_empty() { return "empty".to_string(); }
    let mut out = String::new();
    for ch in s.chars() {
        if ch.is_alphanumeric() || ch=='-' || ch=='_' || ch=='.' { out.push(ch); } else { out.push('_'); }
    }
    out
}
