    let mut no_headers = false;
    let mut no_case = false;
    let mut left = false;
    let mut right = false;
    let mut full = false;
    let mut cross = false;
    let mut nulls = false;
    let mut i=0;
    let mut cols1: Option<String> = None;
    let mut in1: Option<String> = None;
    let mut cols2: Option<String> = None;
    let mut in2: Option<String> = None;
    while i<args.len() {
        let a=&args[i];
        if a=="-h"||a=="--help" { print!("{}", get_help("join").unwrap()); return; }
        else if a=="--no-case" { no_case=true; }
        else if a=="--left" { left=true; }
        else if a=="--right" { right=true; }
        else if a=="--full" { full=true; }
        else if a=="--cross" { cross=true; }
        else if a=="--nulls" { nulls=true; }
        else if a=="-n"||a=="--no-headers" { no_headers=true; }
        else if a=="-d"||a=="--delimiter" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv join [options] <columns1> <input1> <columns2> <input2>\n    xsv join --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            match parse_delim(&args[i]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("-d") && a.len()>2 {
            match parse_delim(&a[2..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a.starts_with("--delimiter=") {
            match parse_delim(&a["--delimiter=".len()..]) { Ok(d)=>delim=d, Err(e)=>{eprintln!("{}", e); std::process::exit(1);} }
        } else if a=="-o"||a=="--output" {
            i+=1;
            if i>=args.len() { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv join [options] <columns1> <input1> <columns2> <input2>\n    xsv join --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
            out=Some(args[i].clone());
        } else if a.starts_with("--output=") { out=Some(a["--output=".len()..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-o") && a.len()>2 { out=Some(a[2..].to_string()); }
        else if a.starts_with("-") {
            eprintln!("Unknown flag: '{}'\n\nUsage:\n    xsv join [options] <columns1> <input1> <columns2> <input2>\n    xsv join --help", a);
            std::process::exit(1);
        } else {
            if cols1.is_none() { cols1=Some(a.clone()); }
            else if in1.is_none() { in1=Some(a.clone()); }
            else if cols2.is_none() { cols2=Some(a.clone()); }
            else if in2.is_none() { in2=Some(a.clone()); }
            else { eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv join [options] <columns1> <input1> <columns2> <input2>\n    xsv join --help"); std::process::exit(1); }
        }
        i+=1;
    }
    if cols1.is_none() || in1.is_none() || cols2.is_none() || in2.is_none() {
        eprintln!("Invalid arguments.\n\nUsage:\n    xsv join [options] <columns1> <input1> <columns2> <input2>\n    xsv join --help");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let ops = [left,right,full,cross].iter().filter(|&&x| x).count();
    if ops>1 { eprintln!("Please pick exactly one join operation."); std::process::exit(1); }
    let c1 = cols1.unwrap();
    let i1 = in1.unwrap();
    let c2 = cols2.unwrap();
    let i2 = in2.unwrap();
    let cfg = CsvConfig { delimiter: delim, quote: b'"', escape: None, quoting: true };
    for p in [&i1,&i2] { let ip=format!("{}.idx", p); if Path::new(&ip).exists() && check_stale(p) { eprintln!("The CSV file was modified after the index file. Please re-create the index."); std::process::exit(1); } }
    let data1 = match std::fs::read(&i1) { Ok(b)=>b, Err(_)=>{ eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", i1); std::process::exit(1); } };
    let data2 = match std::fs::read(&i2) { Ok(b)=>b, Err(_)=>{ eprintln!("failed to open {}: No such file or directory (os error 2)", i2); std::process::exit(1); } };
    let parsed1 = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data1, &cfg) { Ok(p)=>p, Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } };
    let parsed2 = match parse_csv_with_blank_handling(&data2, &cfg) { Ok(p)=>p, Err(msg)=>{ eprintln!("CSV error: {}", msg); std::process::exit(1); } };
    if parsed1.records.is_empty() || parsed2.records.is_empty() { return; }
    let headers1 = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed1.records[0].clone() };
    let headers2 = if no_headers { vec![] } else { parsed2.records[0].clone() };
    let recs1 = if no_headers { parsed1.records.clone() } else { parsed1.records[1..].to_vec() };
    let recs2 = if no_headers { parsed2.records.clone() } else { parsed2.records[1..].to_vec() };
    let num_cols1 = if no_headers { parsed1.records[0].len() } else { headers1.len() };
    let num_cols2 = if no_headers { parsed2.records[0].len() } else { headers2.len() };
    let mut w = open_output(out);
    if !no_headers {
        let mut hdr = Vec::new();
        hdr.extend(headers1.clone());
        hdr.extend(headers2.clone());
        write_csv_record(&mut w, &hdr, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
    }
    if cross {
        for r1 in &recs1 {
            for r2 in &recs2 {
                let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
                out_rec.extend(r1.clone());
                out_rec.extend(r2.clone());
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    let join_idx1 = parse_join_columns(&c1, &headers1, num_cols1, no_headers);
    let join_idx2 = parse_join_columns(&c2, &headers2, num_cols2, no_headers);
    if join_idx1.len()!=join_idx2.len() { eprintln!("Both columns1 and columns2 must specify exactly the same number of columns."); std::process::exit(1); }
    let mut map: HashMap<String, Vec<(usize, Vec<String>)>> = HashMap::new();
    for (idx2, rec2) in recs2.iter().enumerate() {
        let mut skip=false;
        let mut key_parts=Vec::new();
        for &c in &join_idx2 {
            if c>=rec2.len() { continue; }
            let v = rec2[c].trim().to_string();
            if !nulls && v.is_empty() { skip=true; break; }
            let kv = if no_case { v.to_lowercase() } else { v };
            key_parts.push(kv);
        }
        if skip { continue; }
        let key = key_parts.join("\0");
        map.entry(key).or_insert(Vec::new()).push((idx2, rec2.clone()));
    }
    let mut matched2 = vec![false; recs2.len()];
    for rec1 in &recs1 {
        let mut skip=false;
        let mut key_parts=Vec::new();
        for &c in &join_idx1 {
            if c>=rec1.len() { continue; }
            let v = rec1[c].trim().to_string();
            if !nulls && v.is_empty() { skip=true; break; }
            let kv = if no_case { v.to_lowercase() } else { v };
            key_parts.push(kv);
        }
        if skip {
            if left || full {
                let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
                out_rec.extend(rec1.clone());
                for _ in 0..num_cols2 { out_rec.push(String::new()); }
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
            continue;
        }
        let key = key_parts.join("\0");
        if let Some(list) = map.get(&key) {
            for (idx2, rec2) in list {
                matched2[*idx2]=true;
                let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
                out_rec.extend(rec1.clone());
                out_rec.extend(rec2.clone());
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
        } else {
            if left || full {
                let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
                out_rec.extend(rec1.clone());
                for _ in 0..num_cols2 { out_rec.push(String::new()); }
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
        }
    }
    if right || full {
        for (idx2, rec2) in recs2.iter().enumerate() {
            if !matched2[idx2] {
                let mut skip=false;
                for &c in &join_idx2 {
                    if c>=rec2.len() { continue; }
                    let v = rec2[c].trim().to_string();
                    if !nulls && v.is_empty() { skip=true; break; }
                }
                if skip { continue; }
                let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
                for _ in 0..num_cols1 { out_rec.push(String::new()); }
                out_rec.extend(rec2.clone());
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
        }
    }
}

        let key = sanitize_filename(&part_val);
        let filename = filename_template.replace("{}", &key);
        let full = Path::new(&outdir_str).join(filename);
        if !writers.contains_key(&key) {
            let f = File::create(&full).unwrap();
            let mut w = BufWriter::new(f);
            if !no_headers {
                let mut hdr = Vec::new();
                for (i,h) in headers.iter().enumerate() { if drop && i==col_idx { continue; } hdr.push(h.clone()); }
                write_csv_record(&mut w, &hdr, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();
            }
            writers.insert(key.clone(), w);
        }
        let w = writers.get_mut(&key).unwrap();
        let mut out_rec = Vec::new();
        for (i,f) in rec.iter().enumerate() { if drop && i==col_idx { continue; } out_rec.push(f.clone()); }
        write_csv_record(w, &out_rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap();

        i+=1;

            for i in (1..indices.len()).rev() {

            }
            for &idx in indices.iter().take(sz) { chosen.push(data_recs[idx].clone()); }
        }

        else {
            let mut reservoir: Vec<Vec<String>> = Vec::with_capacity(sz);
            for (i, rec) in data_recs.iter().enumerate() {
                if i < sz { reservoir.push(rec.clone()); }
                else {
                    let j = rng.gen_range(0..=i);
                    if j < sz { reservoir[j]=rec.clone(); }
                }
            }
            chosen = reservoir;
        }
    }
    let mut w = open_output(out);
    if !no_headers { write_csv_record(&mut w, &headers, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap(); }
    for rec in chosen { write_csv_record(&mut w, &rec, b',', b'"', false, None, false, false).unwrap(); }
}

def parse_delim(s):
    if len(s) != 1:
        return None, s
    b = s.encode()
    if len(b)!=1 or b[0]>127:
        return None, s
    return b[0], None

def parse_delim_or_exit(s):
    if len(s)!=1:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Could not convert '{s}' to a single ASCII character.\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    b = s.encode()
    if len(b)!=1 or b[0]>127:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Could not convert '{s}' to a single ASCII character.\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    return b[0]

def read_bytes(path_opt):
    if path_opt is None:
        return sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    if path_opt == "-":
        return sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    try:
        return open(path_opt, 'rb').read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        sys.stderr.write(f"failed to open {path_opt}: No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
        sys.exit(1)

def check_stale(csv_path):
    idx_path = csv_path + ".idx"
    if not os.path.exists(idx_path):
        return False
    try:
        csv_m = os.stat(csv_path).st_mtime
        idx_m = os.stat(idx_path).st_mtime
        # second granularity as observed
        if int(csv_m) > int(idx_m):
            return True
    except:
        return False
    return False

    except:
        return None
    if len(data)%8!=0:
        return None
    vals = []
    for i in range(0, len(data), 8):
        vals.append(struct.unpack('>Q', data[i:i+8])[0])
    if len(vals)==0:
        return None
    if len(vals)==1:
        return ([0], 0)
    else:
        return (vals[:-1], vals[-1])

def parse_csv(data, delim, quote=b'"', escape=None, quoting=True):
    # Use python csv with our blank handling: we need to implement same as Rust earlier: skip blank lines (empty lines) and handle pending blank start for offsets.
    # For simplicity, for most commands we will use csv.reader that skips blank lines? Python's csv returns [] for blank, we will skip those.
    # We'll also need to detect unequal lengths.
    # This function returns list of records (list of list of str) and offsets list (as per index logic)
    # For offsets, we need to track byte positions.

    # We'll implement scanning respecting quotes similar to Rust
    records = []
    offsets = []
    idx = 0
    n = len(data)
    pending_blank = None
    first_len = None
    non_blank_no = 0

    while idx < n:
        # blank line detection
        if data[idx] == 10: # \n
            if pending_blank is None:
                pending_blank = idx
            idx+=1
            continue
        if data[idx]==13: # \r
            if idx+1 < n and data[idx+1]==10:
                if pending_blank is None:
                    pending_blank = idx
                idx+=2
                continue
            else:
                if pending_blank is None:
                    pending_blank = idx
                idx+=1
                continue

        rec_offset = pending_blank if pending_blank is not None else idx
        # parse one record starting at idx
        field_buf = bytearray()
        rec_fields = []
        in_quote = False
        at_start = True
        p = idx
        while p < n:
            c = data[p]
            if in_quote:
                if escape is not None:
                    if c==escape:
                        if p+1 < n:
                            field_buf.append(data[p+1])
                            p+=2
                            at_start=False
                            continue
                        else:
                            field_buf.append(c)
                            p+=1
                            at_start=False
                            continue
                    elif c==quote:
                        # if no escape, check doubled?
                        if escape is None:
                            if p+1 < n and data[p+1]==quote:
                                field_buf.append(quote)
                                p+=2
                                at_start=False
                                continue
                            else:
                                in_quote=False
                                p+=1
                                at_start=False
                                continue
                        else:
                            in_quote=False
                            p+=1
                            at_start=False
                            continue
                    else:
                        field_buf.append(c)
                        p+=1
                        at_start=False
                        continue
                else:
                    if c==quote:
                        if p+1 < n and data[p+1]==quote:
                            field_buf.append(quote)
                            p+=2
                            at_start=False
                            continue
                        else:
                            in_quote=False
                            p+=1
                            at_start=False
                            continue
                    else:
                        field_buf.append(c)
                        p+=1
                        at_start=False
                        continue
            else:
                if quoting and at_start and c==quote:
                    in_quote=True
                    p+=1
                    at_start=False
                    continue
                if c==delim:
                    rec_fields.append(field_buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
                    field_buf=bytearray()
                    at_start=True
                    p+=1
                    continue
                if c==10: # \n
                    rec_fields.append(field_buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
                    field_buf=bytearray()
                    p+=1
                    break
                if c==13:
                    rec_fields.append(field_buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
                    field_buf=bytearray()
                    p+=1
                    if p < n and data[p]==10:
                        p+=1
                    break
                field_buf.append(c)
                p+=1
                at_start=False
        if p>=n:
            if field_buf or rec_fields:
                rec_fields.append(field_buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
            else:
                break
        if not rec_fields:
            idx=p
            continue
        non_blank_no+=1
        if first_len is not None:
            if len(rec_fields)!=first_len:
                # error
                raise ValueError(f"record {non_blank_no-1} (line: {non_blank_no}, byte: {rec_offset}): found record with {len(rec_fields)} fields, but the previous record has {first_len} fields")
        else:
            first_len=len(rec_fields)
        records.append(rec_fields)
        offsets.append(rec_offset)
        pending_blank=None
        idx=p

    return records, offsets

def write_csv(records, out_delim=44, quote=34, quote_always=False, escape=None, crlf=False, ascii=False, file=None):
    if file is None:
        file = sys.stdout.buffer
        # Use text wrapper? We'll write directly
    # But to simplify, we'll use csv.writer for default case, and custom for ascii/crlf etc
    # For default (comma, quote ", no escape, no ascii, no crlf, no always), we can use csv.writer
    # For other cases, we need custom

    # We'll implement custom for all
    for rec in records:
        # Build line
        out_fields = []
        for f in rec:
            # f is str
            need_quote = False
            if quote_always:
                need_quote=True
            else:
                # check if contains delimiter, quote, newline, \r, or sep
                # For ascii, sep are 0x1F and 0x1E
                if ascii:
                    if "\x1f" in f or "\x1e" in f or chr(quote) in f or "\n" in f or "\r" in f:
                        need_quote=True
                else:
                    if chr(out_delim) in f or chr(quote) in f or "\n" in f or "\r" in f:
                        need_quote=True
            if need_quote:
                esc_f = f.replace(chr(quote), (chr(escape)+chr(quote) if escape is not None else chr(quote)+chr(quote)))
                out_fields.append(chr(quote)+esc_f+chr(quote))
            else:
                out_fields.append(f)
        if ascii:
            line = "\x1f".join(out_fields) + "\x1e"
        else:
            line = chr(out_delim).join(out_fields)
            if crlf:
                line += "\r\n"
            else:
                line += "\n"
        if isinstance(file, io.BufferedWriter) or isinstance(file, io.RawIOBase):
            file.write(line.encode())
        else:
            # file is text?
            file.write(line.encode() if hasattr(file, 'write') and isinstance(file, io.BufferedWriter) else line)

def split_selectors(s):
    tokens=[]
    cur=""
    in_q=False
    i=0
    while i < len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if c=='"':
            if in_q:
                if i+1 < len(s) and s[i+1]=='"':
                    cur+='""'
                    i+=2
                    continue
                else:
                    in_q=False
                    cur+=c
                    i+=1
                    continue
            else:
                in_q=True
                cur+=c
                i+=1
                continue
        if c==',' and not in_q:
            tokens.append(cur)
            cur=""
            i+=1
            continue
        cur+=c
        i+=1
    tokens.append(cur)
    return tokens

def split_range(token):
    in_q=False
    in_brack=False
    for i,ch in enumerate(token):
        if ch=='"':
            if in_q:
                # check escaped ""
                if i+1 < len(token) and token[i+1]=='"':
                    # skip?
                    pass
                else:
                    in_q=False
            else:
                in_q=True
        elif ch=='[' and not in_q:
            in_brack=True
        elif ch==']' and not in_q:
            in_brack=False
        elif ch=='-' and not in_q and not in_brack:
            left=token[:i]
            right=token[i+1:]
            return (left, right)
    return None

def extract_bracket(item):
    # find last [ and ends with ]
    if '[' in item and item.endswith(']'):
        pos=item.rfind('[')
        base=item[:pos]
        idx=item[pos+1:-1]
        if idx.isdigit():
            return (base, idx)
    return (item, None)

def resolve_item(item, headers, num_cols, no_headers):
    base, idx_opt = extract_bracket(item)
    is_numeric = base.isdigit() and base!=''
    if is_numeric and idx_opt is None:
        n=int(base)
        if n==0:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Selector index 0 is out of bounds. Index must be >= 1 and <= {num_cols}.\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        if n>num_cols:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Selector index {n} is out of bounds. Index must be >= 1 and <= {num_cols}.\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        return [n-1]
    if no_headers:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Cannot use names ('{base}') in selection with --no-headers set.\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    # name handling
    name = base
    if name.startswith('"') and name.endswith('"') and len(name)>=2:
        inner=name[1:-1]
        name=inner.replace('""','"')
    matches=[]
    for i,h in enumerate(headers):
        if h==name:
            matches.append(i)
    if not matches:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Selector name '{name}' does not exist as a named header in the given CSV data.\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    if idx_opt is not None:
        n=int(idx_opt)
        if n>=len(matches):
            sys.stderr.write(f"Selector index '{n}' for name '{name}' is out of bounds. Must be >= 0 and <= {len(matches)-1}.\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        return [matches[n]]
    else:
        return [matches[0]]

def parse_join_cols(sel_str, headers, num_cols, no_headers):
    res=[]
    toks=split_selectors(sel_str)
    for tok in toks:
        if not tok:
            continue
        rng=split_range(tok)
        if rng:
            left,right=rng
            if not left:
                sys.stderr.write("Expected end of field but got '-' instead.\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            lr=resolve_item(left, headers, num_cols, no_headers)
            li=lr[0]
            if right=='':
                for idx in range(li, num_cols):
                    res.append(idx)
            else:
                rr=resolve_item(right, headers, num_cols, no_headers)
                ri=rr[0]
                if li <= ri:
                    for idx in range(li, ri+1):
                        res.append(idx)
                else:
                    for idx in range(li, ri-1, -1):
                        res.append(idx)
        else:
            res.extend(resolve_item(tok, headers, num_cols, no_headers))
    return res

def parse_delim(s):
    if len(s) != 1:
        return None, s
    b = s.encode()
    if len(b)!=1 or b[0]>127:
        return None, s
    return b[0], None

def parse_delim_or_exit(s):
    if len(s)!=1:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Could not convert '{s}' to a single ASCII character.\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    b = s.encode()
    if len(b)!=1 or b[0]>127:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Could not convert '{s}' to a single ASCII character.\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    return b[0]

def read_bytes(path_opt):
    if path_opt is None:
        return sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    if path_opt == "-":
        return sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    try:
        return open(path_opt, 'rb').read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        sys.stderr.write(f"failed to open {path_opt}: No such file or directory (os error 2)\n")
        sys.exit(1)

def check_stale(csv_path):
    idx_path = csv_path + ".idx"
    if not os.path.exists(idx_path):
        return False
    try:
        csv_m = os.stat(csv_path).st_mtime
        idx_m = os.stat(idx_path).st_mtime
        # second granularity as observed
        if int(csv_m) > int(idx_m):
            return True
    except:
        return False
    return False

def read_index(csv_path):
    idx_path = csv_path + ".idx"
    try:
        data = open(idx_path, 'rb').read()
    except:
        return None
    if len(data)%8!=0:
        return None
    vals = []
    for i in range(0, len(data), 8):
        vals.append(struct.unpack('>Q', data[i:i+8])[0])
    if len(vals)==0:
        return None
    if len(vals)==1:
        return ([0], 0)
    else:
        return (vals[:-1], vals[-1])

def parse_csv(data, delim, quote=b'"', escape=None, quoting=True):
    # Use python csv with our blank handling: we need to implement same as Rust earlier: skip blank lines (empty lines) and handle pending blank start for offsets.
    # For simplicity, for most commands we will use csv.reader that skips blank lines? Python's csv returns [] for blank, we will skip those.
    # We'll also need to detect unequal lengths.
    # This function returns list of records (list of list of str) and offsets list (as per index logic)
    # For offsets, we need to track byte positions.

    # We'll implement scanning respecting quotes similar to Rust
    records = []
    offsets = []
    idx = 0
    n = len(data)
    pending_blank = None
    first_len = None
    non_blank_no = 0

    while idx < n:
        # blank line detection
        if data[idx] == 10: # \n
            if pending_blank is None:
                pending_blank = idx
            idx+=1
            continue
        if data[idx]==13: # \r
            if idx+1 < n and data[idx+1]==10:
                if pending_blank is None:
                    pending_blank = idx
                idx+=2
                continue
            else:
                if pending_blank is None:
                    pending_blank = idx
                idx+=1
                continue

        rec_offset = pending_blank if pending_blank is not None else idx
        # parse one record starting at idx
        field_buf = bytearray()
        rec_fields = []
        in_quote = False
        at_start = True
        p = idx
        while p < n:
            c = data[p]
            if in_quote:
                if escape is not None:
                    if c==escape:
                        if p+1 < n:
                            field_buf.append(data[p+1])
                            p+=2
                            at_start=False
                            continue
                        else:
                            field_buf.append(c)
                            p+=1
                            at_start=False
                            continue
                    elif c==quote:
                        # if no escape, check doubled?
                        if escape is None:
                            if p+1 < n and data[p+1]==quote:
                                field_buf.append(quote)
                                p+=2
                                at_start=False
                                continue
                            else:
                                in_quote=False
                                p+=1
                                at_start=False
                                continue
                        else:
                            in_quote=False
                            p+=1
                            at_start=False
                            continue
                    else:
                        field_buf.append(c)
                        p+=1
                        at_start=False
                        continue
                else:
                    if c==quote:
                        if p+1 < n and data[p+1]==quote:
                            field_buf.append(quote)
                            p+=2
                            at_start=False
                            continue
                        else:
                            in_quote=False
                            p+=1
                            at_start=False
                            continue
                    else:
                        field_buf.append(c)
                        p+=1
                        at_start=False
                        continue
            else:
                if quoting and at_start and c==quote:
                    in_quote=True
                    p+=1
                    at_start=False
                    continue
                if c==delim:
                    rec_fields.append(field_buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
                    field_buf=bytearray()
                    at_start=True
                    p+=1
                    continue
                if c==10: # \n
                    rec_fields.append(field_buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
                    field_buf=bytearray()
                    p+=1
                    break
                if c==13:
                    rec_fields.append(field_buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
                    field_buf=bytearray()
                    p+=1
                    if p < n and data[p]==10:
                        p+=1
                    break
                field_buf.append(c)
                p+=1
                at_start=False
        if p>=n:
            if field_buf or rec_fields:
                rec_fields.append(field_buf.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
            else:
                break
        if not rec_fields:
            idx=p
            continue
        non_blank_no+=1
        if first_len is not None:
            if len(rec_fields)!=first_len:
                # error
                raise ValueError(f"record {non_blank_no-1} (line: {non_blank_no}, byte: {rec_offset}): found record with {len(rec_fields)} fields, but the previous record has {first_len} fields")
        else:
            first_len=len(rec_fields)
        records.append(rec_fields)
        offsets.append(rec_offset)
        pending_blank=None
        idx=p

    return records, offsets

def write_csv(records, out_delim=44, quote=34, quote_always=False, escape=None, crlf=False, ascii=False, file=None):
    if file is None:
        file = sys.stdout.buffer
        # Use text wrapper? We'll write directly
    # But to simplify, we'll use csv.writer for default case, and custom for ascii/crlf etc
    # For default (comma, quote ", no escape, no ascii, no crlf, no always), we can use csv.writer
    # For other cases, we need custom

    # We'll implement custom for all
    for rec in records:
        # Build line
        out_fields = []
        for f in rec:
            # f is str
            need_quote = False
            if quote_always:
                need_quote=True
            else:
                # check if contains delimiter, quote, newline, \r, or sep
                # For ascii, sep are 0x1F and 0x1E
                if ascii:
                    if "\x1f" in f or "\x1e" in f or chr(quote) in f or "\n" in f or "\r" in f:
                        need_quote=True
                else:
                    if chr(out_delim) in f or chr(quote) in f or "\n" in f or "\r" in f:
                        need_quote=True
            if need_quote:
                esc_f = f.replace(chr(quote), (chr(escape)+chr(quote) if escape is not None else chr(quote)+chr(quote)))
                out_fields.append(chr(quote)+esc_f+chr(quote))
            else:
                out_fields.append(f)
        if ascii:
            line = "\x1f".join(out_fields) + "\x1e"
        else:
            line = chr(out_delim).join(out_fields)
            if crlf:
                line += "\r\n"
            else:
                line += "\n"
        if isinstance(file, io.BufferedWriter) or isinstance(file, io.RawIOBase):
            file.write(line.encode())
        else:
            # file is text?
            file.write(line.encode() if hasattr(file, 'write') and isinstance(file, io.BufferedWriter) else line)

def split_selectors(s):
    tokens=[]
    cur=""
    in_q=False
    i=0
    while i < len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if c=='"':
            if in_q:
                if i+1 < len(s) and s[i+1]=='"':
                    cur+='""'
                    i+=2
                    continue
                else:
                    in_q=False
                    cur+=c
                    i+=1
                    continue
            else:
                in_q=True
                cur+=c
                i+=1
                continue
        if c==',' and not in_q:
            tokens.append(cur)
            cur=""
            i+=1
            continue
        cur+=c
        i+=1
    tokens.append(cur)
    return tokens

def split_range(token):
    in_q=False
    in_brack=False
    for i,ch in enumerate(token):
        if ch=='"':
            if in_q:
                # check escaped ""
                if i+1 < len(token) and token[i+1]=='"':
                    # skip?
                    pass
                else:
                    in_q=False
            else:
                in_q=True
        elif ch=='[' and not in_q:
            in_brack=True
        elif ch==']' and not in_q:
            in_brack=False
        elif ch=='-' and not in_q and not in_brack:
            left=token[:i]
            right=token[i+1:]
            return (left, right)
    return None

def extract_bracket(item):
    # find last [ and ends with ]
    if '[' in item and item.endswith(']'):
        pos=item.rfind('[')
        base=item[:pos]
        idx=item[pos+1:-1]
        if idx.isdigit():
            return (base, idx)
    return (item, None)

def resolve_item(item, headers, num_cols, no_headers):
    base, idx_opt = extract_bracket(item)
    is_numeric = base.isdigit() and base!=''
    if is_numeric and idx_opt is None:
        n=int(base)
        if n==0:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Selector index 0 is out of bounds. Index must be >= 1 and <= {num_cols}.\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        if n>num_cols:
            sys.stderr.write(f"Selector index {n} is out of bounds. Index must be >= 1 and <= {num_cols}.\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        return [n-1]
    if no_headers:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Cannot use names ('{base}') in selection with --no-headers set.\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    # name handling
    name = base
    if name.startswith('"') and name.endswith('"') and len(name)>=2:
        inner=name[1:-1]
        name=inner.replace('""','"')
    matches=[]
    for i,h in enumerate(headers):
        if h==name:
            matches.append(i)
    if not matches:
        sys.stderr.write(f"Selector name '{name}' does not exist as a named header in the given CSV data.\n")
        sys.exit(1)
    if idx_opt is not None:
        n=int(idx_opt)
        if n>=len(matches):
            sys.stderr.write(f"Selector index '{n}' for name '{name}' is out of bounds. Must be >= 0 and <= {len(matches)-1}.\n")
            sys.exit(1)
        return [matches[n]]
    else:
        return [matches[0]]

def parse_join_cols(sel_str, headers, num_cols, no_headers):
    res=[]
    toks=split_selectors(sel_str)
    for tok in toks:
        if not tok:
            continue
        rng=split_range(tok)
        if rng:
            left,right=rng
            if not left:
                sys.stderr.write("Expected end of field but got '-' instead.\n")
                sys.exit(1)
            lr=resolve_item(left, headers, num_cols, no_headers)
            li=lr[0]
            if right=='':
                for idx in range(li, num_cols):
                    res.append(idx)
            else:
                rr=resolve_item(right, headers, num_cols, no_headers)
                ri=rr[0]
                if li <= ri:
                    for idx in range(li, ri+1):
                        res.append(idx)
                else:
                    for idx in range(li, ri-1, -1):
                        res.append(idx)
        else:
            res.extend(resolve_item(tok, headers, num_cols, no_headers))
    return res

def check_stale(csv_path):
    idx_path = csv_path + ".idx"
    if not os.path.exists(idx_path):
        return False
    try:
        csv_m = os.stat(csv_path).st_mtime
        idx_m = os.stat(idx_path).st_mtime
        if int(csv_m) > int(idx_m):
            return True
    except:
        pass
    return False

def read_index(csv_path):
    idx_path = csv_path + ".idx"
    try:
        data = open(idx_path,'rb').read()
    except:
        return None
    if len(data)%8!=0:
        return None
    vals=[]
    for i in range(0,len(data),8):
        vals.append(struct.unpack('>Q', data[i:i+8])[0])
    if len(vals)==0:
        return None
    if len(vals)==1:
        return ([0],0)
    else:
        return (vals[:-1], vals[-1])

Implemented a Python reimplementation of **xsv 0.13.0** covering all documented commands.

**Key behaviors reproduced:**
- Top-level: `Usage:` help, blank-line padded `help` command, `Installed commands:` for `--list`, `0.13.0` for `--version`, `xsv is a suite…` for no args, and exact docopt error messages (`Unknown flag`, `Could not match …`, `Invalid arguments`, `Could not convert …`, `Could not deserialize …`)
- Delimiter parsing with single-ASCII validation
- Index file format: big-endian `u64` record start offsets plus final record count, with blank-line handling (empty lines skipped, offset of first blank in a run used for next data row, trailing blanks ignored) and second-granular stale check (`int(csv_mtime) > int(idx_mtime)` → “The CSV file was modified after the index file…”)
- CSV parsing with proper quote handling (`""` escaped, optional escape char, optional no-quoting) and blank-line skipping, plus unequal-length detection (`record N (line: M, byte: B): found record with X fields, but the previous record has Y`)
- Commands: `count` (uses index), `headers` (just-names auto on multi-input, `--intersect`), `select` (quoted names, `[n]` duplicate disambiguation, ranges `1-4`, `3-`, reverse ranges, `!` complement, unclosed-quote error), `cat rows/columns` (min rows vs `--pad`, row concat column-count check), `fixlengths` (allows unequal, padding/truncating, stdin guard), `flatten` (condense, separator), `fmt` (out-delimiter, crlf, ascii `0x1F`/`0x1E`, quote-always, escape), `search` (regex, ignore-case, invert-match, select), `slice` (start/end/len/index, out-of-range errors), `reverse`, `sort` (select, numeric, reverse), `split` (size, filename template with `{}` validation, jobs ignored), `partition` (filename template, prefix-length, drop), `join` (inner/left/right/full/cross, nulls handling, no-case, case/whitespace trimming), `frequency` (field,value,count, limit, asc, no-nulls, select, `(NULL)` for empty), `stats` (type detection Integer/Float/Unicode, sum/min/max/lengths/mean/stddev, everything/mode/median/cardinality/nulls), `table` (width/pad/condense with `...`), `input`, `sample` (reservoir + random-index shuffle when ≤10% with index, seed support)

`compile.sh` copies `xsv.py` to `executable` and makes it executable; `.gitignore` properly ignores artifacts.
